property.name: Geometry
property.description: Gets the container used by the icon to store its geometry.

property.name: Layer
property.description: Defines the layer the icon belongs to in the 3D world.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the icon's name.

property.name: Uri
property.description: Defines the URI of the icon file.

method.name: createProperty
method.description: Adds a new user-defined property of a given type and name to action, and then returns the new property. An optional constraints argument can be given to define the constraints of the property, which must be given at the time of creation. See Property constants for available property types and constraints.

method.name: deleteProperty
method.description: Deletes a given property from action.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns the first property matching a given name in action; otherwise returns None.

method.name: send
method.description:
Sends action to the defined container.
If no arguments are given, the action is broadcast to all connected Action Containers.

method.name: sendMessage
method.description: Sends action with a given message to all connected Action Containers. An optional container argument can be given to specify which action container receives the action. Generally, the message of an action defines the action's type and is used by an action container to execute the action. In some cases, the message is used to filter actions.

property.name: ActionContainer
property.description: Gets the action container of action.

property.name: ActionTime
property.description: Gets the creation time of action.

property.name: AllProperties
property.description: Gets a list of all user-defined properties for the action.

property.name: Filter
property.description: Defines a filter for limiting what resource can perform the action.

property.name: From
property.description: Defines the original sender of this action. Generally, this is used to track and manipulate where an action is sent from. For example, an action might be forwarded and passed to different resources and task managers.

property.name: Message
property.description: Defines the status information about the action's execution.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of action.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list of all user-defined properties created for the action after the action container was loaded.

property.name: Receiver
property.description: Defines the receiver of action in its current workflow. For example, an action might need to be handled at a workstation before the action is sent to a target defined by its To property.

property.name: Sender
property.description: Defines the current sender of the action. Generally, this is used to clearly identify which object is responsible for sending this action.

property.name: To
property.description:
Defines the final target where the action should be sent to.
In some cases, an action's final destination might be redefined to handle issues such as quality inspections, rerouting of materials, and availability of resource providers.

method.name: clear
method.description: Deletes all actions in container.

method.name: clearPending
method.description: Deletes all pending actions in container.

method.name: createAction
method.description: Creates a new vcAction in container, and then returns the new action.

method.name: createPendingAction
method.description: Creates a new pending action in the container.

method.name: deleteAction
method.description: Deletes a given action or one at a given index from container. If deletion is successful, returns True; otherwise returns False.

method.name: deletePendingAction
method.description: Deletes a given action from the PendingActions property list.

method.name: do
method.description: Executes an action using the container. If action can be performed, returns True; otherwise returns False. Each action type has its own set of arguments which are described in Action Constants. Action arguments can be added in the order how they are described in the action parameter table. An alternative approach is to use Python keywords, which allows only using specific keyword arguments. See list of possible action types and their arguments.

method.name: getAction
method.description: Returns an action found at the given index in container.

method.name: getPendingAction
method.description: Returns a pending action found at a given index in container.

method.name: getResources
method.description: Returns a list of immediate resources connected to container.

method.name: moveAction
method.description: Moves a given action to a given index in Actions property list. If moving is successful, returns True; otherwise returns False.

method.name: movePendingAction
method.description: Moves a given action to a new position in the PendingActions property list. If moving is successful, returns True, otherwise False is returned.

method.name: popPending
method.description: Removes the last action from the PendingActions property list, and then returns that action; otherwise returns None. If an index argument is given, the action found at that position in the PendingActions property list will be removed and returned by the method; otherwise, returns None.

method.name: release
removePendingAction
method.description: Removes a given action from the PendingActions property list.

method.name: reserve
method.description: Reserves a resource provider matching resource_filter, and then returns the reserved resource. If resource is not available immediately, the method will wait until resource is available. If no matching resource is available, the method returns None. An optional action_type argument can be given to reserve the resource for a specific action. See list of possible action types. An optional Timeout argument can be given to define how long the method will wait (in seconds) in order to reserve a resource. If the resource cannot be reserved before Timeout expires, the method returns None.

method.name: start
method.description: Executes an action using container regardless if an other action is still running. If action can be performed, returns True; otherwise returns False. Generally, start() is used with the wait() method in order to catch when an action executed with start() has been completed. Each action type has its own set of arguments which are described in Action Constants. Action arguments can be added in the order how they are described in the action parameter table. An alternative approach is to use Python keywords, which allows only using specific keyword arguments. See list of possible action types.

method.name: use
method.description: Executes an action using a specific resource. If no resource is found based on resource_filter and the action is available immediately (not in queue), the method will wait until the specified resource is available. If resource can be used to perform action, returns True; otherwise returns False. Optional timeout keyword argument defines how long the method will wait (in seconds) for the reserved resource to become available. If resource cannot be reserved before timeout expires, return False. Each action type has its own set of arguments which are described in Action Constants. Action arguments can be added in the order how they are described in the action parameter table. An alternative approach is to use Python keywords, which allows only using specific keyword arguments. See list of possible action types.

method.name: wait
method.description: Waits until action called in start() method is completed, and then returns True. If an optional timeout argument is used, the method will return False if an action is not completed within the allocated time period (in seconds).

property.name: ActionCount
property.description: Gets the total number of actions in container.

property.name: Actions
property.description: Gets a list of all actions in container.

property.name: Brokers
property.description: Defines a list of connected brokers.

property.name: Clients
property.description: Defines a list of connected clients.

property.name: PendingActionCount
property.description: Gets the number of actions in the PendingActions property list.

property.name: NextFreeTime
property.description: Defines the next available time this container is able to process actions during a simulation.

property.name: PendingActions
property.description: Gets a list of pending action stored in the container. That is, actions that are received from other action containers and buffered for action processing.

property.name: Processing
property.description: Defines if this container is executing actions.

property.name: Providers
property.description: Defines a list of connected providers.

property.name: Reserved
property.description: Defines if this container is reserved by other action container.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns a property matching a given name in the annotation; otherwise returns None.

property.name: Height
property.description: Defines the height of text displayed in annotation.

property.name: LineWidth
property.description: Defines the line width of annotation.

property.name: Location
property.description: Defines the position matrix of annotation in World coordinate system).

property.name: LockToNode
property.description: Defines if the annotation is attached to a node in component. That is, whether or not the annotation is anchored to a component or 3D world.

property.name: Material
property.description: Defines the material of annotation.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the annotation's name.

property.name: Node
property.description:
Defines the node the annotation is attached to in the 3D world.
If the annotation is not locked to a node, the value is None.

property.name: Position
property.description: Defines the location of the annotation in its parent's coordinate system. That is, the anchor point of the annotation. If the annotation is not anchored to a component, the location is based in the World (simulation root node) coordinate system.

property.name: Text
property.description: Defines the text of the annotation displayed in an environment.

property.name: Thickness
property.description: Defines the thickness of the annotation's text in an environment.

method.name: loadBitmap
method.description:
Loads a bitmap image from a given uri.
If loading is successful, the bitmap's filename is used to register the bitmap with the application. Returns the loaded bitmap image; otherwise returns None.

method.name: saveBitmap
method.description: Writes a given bitmap to a given uri. By default, the bitmap is saved as a BMP file. An optional writer_info argument can be given to write the bitmap to a different format. rbmp writes to BMP. rjpegstd or rjpegnstd writes to JPEG. rpng writes to PNG. rtargareader writes to TGA. See vcBitmap for more information.

method.name: findCamera
method.description:
Returns a camera used by the application in an environment.
An optional name argument can be given to find a specific camera; otherwise the method returns the first found camera. If no camera is found, returns None.

method.name: cancelCommand
method.description: Cancels the execution of the currently active command, after which the default command of the application is activated. An optional all argument of can be given to cancel all commands in the command stack or just the top-most command by giving a False value.

method.name: deleteCommand
method.description: Deletes a registered command that matches a given name.

method.name: findCommand
method.description: Returns a registered command that matches a given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: getCommands
method.description: Returns a list of commands registered to the application.

method.name: loadCommand
method.description: Loads a defined script of a given name at a given uri into the application as a Python command. Loading registers a command with the given name in the application, which can be used to launch the command itself. Successful command loading returns the command as an object; otherwise, returns None.

method.name: clearWorld
method.description: Removes all components from the 3D world.

method.name: cloneComponent
method.description: Clones a given component, and then returns the clone. Note: This is only for static components when simulation is not running. To clone components when a simulation is running, use vcComponent.clone().

method.name: connectComponents
method.description:
Connects all matching interfaces between two given components.
If a physical connection requires repositioning then comp2 is snapped to comp1. If a connection forms a parent-child hierarchy, the child component is moved and attached to the parent component.

method.name: createComponent
method.description: Creates a new component at the 3D world origin, and then returns the new component.

method.name: deleteComponent
method.description: Deletes a given component from the 3D world.

method.name: findComponent
method.description: Returns a component in the 3D world that matches a given name. If no match is found, returns None.

method.name: createLayout
method.description: Creates a new empty simulation layout.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads a component from a given uri in the 3D world. If loading is successful, returns the component; otherwise returns None. Note: In most cases, the file URI scheme is file:/// followed by the full path to file.

method.name: setContext
method.description:
Sets the context of application to the given id.
Standard ids are: Author Component modeling Configure Layout configuration Drawing 2D drawing Teach Robot programming.

method.name: beginFrameGrab
method.description: Starts frame grabbing process using given image_format, image_width and image_height arguments to use with the executeFrameGrab() method.
method.parameters: String image_format, Integer image_width, Integer image_height

method.name: endFrameGrab
method.description: Ends screen grabbing process and performs cleanup.

method.name: executeFrameGrab
method.description: Creates a video frame of the current 3D world view and saves the frame at a given uri. The frame's format and size are defined using the beginFrameGrab() method.

method.name: doJogging
method.description: Does the actual jogging using given vector as a reference location in world coordinates where the jogging ends.

method.name: startJogging
method.description: Initializes jogging process by defining what node is jogged and vector where the jogging starts, that is a reference starting location in the world coordinate system.

method.name: stopJogging
method.description: Stops jogging.

method.name: createLayer
method.description: Creates a new layer with a given name in the application. If a layer with the given name exists, that layer is returned; otherwise the method returns the new layer. If the layer cannot be created, returns None.

method.name: deleteLayer
method.description: Deletes a layer that matches a given name  unless the layer is a system layer.

method.name: findLayer
method.description: Returns a layer that matches a given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: createLayoutItem
method.description: Creates a new layout item of a given type in the current layout. See Layout Item constants for types and descriptions.

method.name: deleteLayoutItem
method.description: Deletes a given layout_item or one that matches a given name from the current layout.

method.name: findLayoutItem
method.description: Returns a layout item that matches a given name in current layout; otherwise returns None.

method.name: createLight
method.description: Creates a new light with a given name which is attached to the 3D world.

method.name: deleteLight
method.description: Deletes a light that matches a given name.

method.name: findLight
method.description: Returns the first found light in the 3D world or a light matching a given name. If no light is found with the given name, returns None.

method.name: addMaterial
method.description: Adds a given material to a group of materials registered with the application. If the material is registered, returns True. If a material with the same name already exists, returns False.

method.name: createMaterial
method.description: Creates a new material with a given name.

method.name: findMaterial
method.description:
Returns a material matching a given name. If no material is found with the name, returns None.
Optional case_sensitive argument can be used to specify if the method is case-sensitive. By default, the method returns the first match (not case-sensitive).

method.name: addMenuButton
method.description: Adds a new menu button in the ribbon (similar to the item). The first three parameters are the same as in addMenuItem, and the toolSize parameter defines the appearance of the button.
method.parameters: String menu, String caption, String command, [Enum toolSize]

method.name: addUxSite
method.description:
Adds a new site identified by siteId at the specified position.
siteId can be a concatenated string or a path, thereby allowing you to specify a section of the user interface. For example, 'VcTabDrawing/Example' would create a new ribbon group called Example in the Drawing tab. Caution: You can refer to the <UXSitesSection> element of your application's configuration file to know valid IDs. Each id is an ItemId attribute of a <Site> element. An optional position parameter specifies the index at which the site should be created in its direct parent.

method.name: addMenuItem
method.description:
Adds a new menu item to a given menu.
The menu argument can be a Menu Constant or id indicating the area of user interface where you want to add the menu item. The caption argument specifies a default label for the menu item. The position parameter specifies where the menu item will be added in the given menu. Any value less than zero is indexed from the end of the menu. By default, a new menu item is appended to the end of a menu.
The command argument specifies a command by name that is executed when you interact with the menu item. For example, you can pass the name of a command registered to the application or an id that can be referenced when adding gallery menu items. The tool_tip argument specifies a default tooltip for the menu item. The image argument specifies the icon of the menu item. The reference_id argument refers to another menu item by its command name or id. Generally, you would use this to add items to a gallery menu on the Ribbon in which both the gallery and its items are created using the same Python command. The control_type argument specifies the control type of the menu item. Generally, you would use this to indicate an item as a GalleryMenuTool or GalleryMenuToolItem. If you are creating a contextual tab group in the Ribbon, you would use this to indicate a ContextualTabGroup or RibbonTab. Each call returns an integer that is a handle for the new menu item. Use that value in the removeMenuItem() method to delete the menu item. See Creating a Python Add-on for more information and examples.
method.parameters: Enumeration menu, String caption, Integer position, String command or String menu, String caption, Integer position, String command or String menu, String caption, Integer position, String command, String tool_tip, String image, String reference_id, String control_type (Deprecated) String menu, String caption, [Integer position], vcCommand command or (Deprecated) String menu, String caption, [Integer position], String command or (Deprecated) Enumeration menu, String caption, [Integer position], vcCommand command or (Deprecated) Enumeration menu, String caption, [Integer position], String command

method.name: createBehaviourMenuItem
method.description: Creates a new menu item in Behavior tab add-on menu. (Deprecated) Use addMenuItem() method.
method.parameters: String menu_name, Integer pos, vcCommand command

method.name: createFeatureMenuItem
method.description: Creates a new menu item in Geometry tab add-on menu. (Deprecated) Use addMenuItem() method.
method.parameters: String menu_name, Integer pos, vcCommand command

method.name: createGeometryMenuItem
method.description: Creates a new menu item in Geometry tab add-on menu. (Deprecated) Use addMenuItem() method.
method.parameters: String menu_name, Integer pos, vcCommand command

method.name: createMenuItem
method.description: Creates a new menu item in Add-ons menu. (Deprecated) Use addMenuItem() method.
method.parameters: String menu_name, Integer pos, vcCommand command

method.name: getLocalizedString
method.description: Gets the value of a given key in a resource file based on the language of the application. Generally, this is used to localize add-ons. If the key is not found, returns the key itself as a string. You have two options: 1-key Pass the entire key, for example "ComboKey::Python.MsgBoxTitle.Text". 3-key Pass the key in three separate arguments, for example ("Python","MsgBoxTitle","Text"). See Template for Python Add-on for an example on how to use this method.

method.name: removeMenuItem
method.description: Remove a menu item that was previously added using the addMenuItem() method.

method.name: setContextualTabGroup
method.description:
Turns on/off the visibility of a contextual tab group in Ribbon.
The tab_id argument refers to the Id of the contextual tab group.

method.name: getSelection
method.description:
Returns a selection object for a given type.
See Selection constants for available types. (Deprecated) Use vcSelectionManager.

method.name: getSelections
method.description: Returns a list of selection objects for all types registered to the application. (Deprecated) Use vcSelectionManager.

method.name: delayRealTime
method.description: Executes a delay (in seconds) that halts a running simulation.

method.name: getSimulation
method.description: Returns the simulation object of application.

method.name: resetSimulation
method.description: Resets the simulation to its initial state. Resetting a simulation removes all dynamic components and returns static components to their initial state at the start of a simulation.

method.name: startSimulation
method.description: Starts a simulation. An optional stop_time argument can be given to indicate when to stop running the simulation. If the simulation of the application is not at its initial state, the simulation will continue from its current state. That is, the simulation clock will not reset to zero.

method.name: stopSimulation
method.description: Immediately stops the execution of a simulation.

method.name: createQuantity
method.description: Create a new quantity of a given name and type. The name argument specifies the full name of the new quantity. The type argument specifies whether a scalar or vector quantity. See Quantity Constants for more information.

method.name: createUnitFamily
method.description: Create a new unit family of a given name in application. The name argument specifies the name of the unit family and may not contain dot characters.

method.name: createUnitGroup
method.description:
Create a new unit group of a given name.
The name argument specifies the name of the unit group and may not contain dot characters.

method.name: deleteUnitFamily
method.description: Deletes a unit family given as an argument. Only user-created unit families can be deleted.

method.name: deleteUnitGroup
method.description: Deletes a unit group given as an argument. Only user-created unit groups can be deleted.

method.name: findQuantity
method.description: Returns a quantity matching a given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: findUnit
method.description: Returns a unit matching a given name; otherwise returns None. This method will try to match either the name or suffix of a unit to the given name.

method.name: findUnitFamily
method.description: Returns a unit family matching a given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: findUnitGroup
method.description: Returns a unit group matching a given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: createView
method.description: Creates a new view of a given name based on the current 3D world view. The view itself is saved with a layout and listed as a User View in the GUI whenever the layout is loaded in the 3D world.

method.name: deleteView
method.description: Deletes a view matching a given name from the current layout.

method.name: findView
method.description: Returns a view matching a given name in the current layout; otherwise returns None.

method.name: setClipPlane
method.description: Sets the clipping plane position.

method.name: setClipPlaneEnabled
method.description: Defines if the clipping plane is enabled or disabled.

method.name: useView
method.description: Switches the view of the 3D world to a view matching a given name in the current layout. An optional time argument can be given to interpolate the linear movement of the camera to new view. That is, a timed camera movement (in seconds).

method.name: autoShareFeatureTrees
method.description:
Shares the feature trees of identical components in 3D world.
For example, exact copies of a conveyor with the same VCID and feature trees can be shared to consume less memory. If you need to make a vcComponent object unique again, edit a property that affects one of its features or call its makeUnique() method.

method.name: clearMessages
method.description: Clears Output panel.

method.name: clearUndo
method.description: Clears the undo history.

method.name: detectFrameOwnerNode
method.description: Returns a node containing the closest Frame feature to a given position based on a distance tolerance. An optional exclude argument can be given to exclude frames belonging to specific node.

method.name: getApplicationPath
method.description: Returns the Uri of this application's script as a formatted string. Generally, this method is used to register a command used in a Python add-on.

method.name: getPythonDllPath
method.description: Returns the Uri of Python DLL folder as a formatted string.

method.name: getRandomSeed
method.description: Returns the integer of a random generator at a given index.

method.name: getMessages
method.description: Returns all messages currently listed in the Output panel.

method.name: messageBox
method.description:
Shows a message box displaying the given message.
An optional title argument can be given to define the title of the message box. An optional type argument can given to define the box type and icon. An optional buttons argument can be given to show a message box with buttons. The method returns a result based on the type of message box and which button is clicked by a user. See Message Constants for more information. See Example on how to implement this method. Warning: If you want to open a message box when you start the application, you should use the OnAppInitialized event to verify it is safe to generate the box.

method.name: rayCast
method.description: Tests if a ray with a given ray_length and start_position intersects an object in the current layout. The position of the ray is based in the World coordinate system, and the length of the ray is directed along the positive Z-axis. An optional exclude_node argument can be given to exclude a node, thereby allowing the ray to cast through and ignore collision with the given node and its child nodes. An optional use_backface argument has a default True value to include geometry backfaces in ray casting. A False value means the ray ignores geometry backfaces. An optional tuple argument of node, inclusion_type and inclusion scope can be given to exclude or include nodes. Excluding nodes allows the ray to cast through and ignore collision with the given nodes. Including one or more nodes will automatically exclude all the other nodes not included. See Collision Detector Constants for more information. If a ray collides with an object, the collision data is returned as tuple with three or five elements; otherwise returns None. See Example on how to implement this method.
method.parameters: vcMatrix start_position, Real ray_length, [vcNode exclude_node], [Boolean use_backface], [List of 3-tuple (vcNode node, Enumeration inclusion_type, Enumeration inclusion_scope)]

method.name: render
method.description: Renders the scene of 3D world.

method.name: save
method.description: Saves the contents of 3D world as a layout using a given uri. Also includecomponents parameter defines if the components are included in the layout.

event.name: OnComponentRemoved

event.name: OnDynamicComponent

event.name: OnIdle
event.description: Triggered when the application is in an Idle state. (Deprecated)

event.name: OnProgress
event.description: Triggered each time the application's progress bar is updated.

event.name: OnRender
event.description: Triggered when the application renders a scene in 3D world.

event.name: OnSelectionPreChange
event.description: Triggered when the selection type of application is changing to a new type. The current selection type is passed as an event argument. (Deprecated) Use vcSelectionManager.

event.name: OnSelectionPostChange
event.description: Triggered when the selection type of the application has changed to a new type. The previous selection type is passed as an argument. (Deprecated) Use vcSelectionManager.

event.name: OnStart
event.description: Triggered at the start of the application when main window is being built. (Deprecated) Use OnAppInitialized.

property.name: ActivationKey
property.description: Gets the floating or stand-alone license that is currently used for the licensing of the application.

property.name: AuthorContext
property.description: Gets the Modeling tab context.

property.name: Commands
property.description: Gets a list of commands in the application's command registry. That is, registered commands available in the application.

property.name: Components
property.description: Gets a list of all components in the 3D world.

property.name: ConfigureContext
property.description: Gets the Home tab context.

property.name: Contexts
property.description: Gets a list of all contexts defined in the application.

property.name: CurrentContext
property.description: Defines the current context of the application.

property.name: CustomProductVersion
property.description: Returns the config file customized product version. If the product name has not been customized, returns the internal version.

property.name: CurrentSelection
property.description: Defines the current selection in the active environment. (Deprecated) Use selection type methods or the SelectionManager property.

property.name: Dashboard
property.description: Gets the Statistics dashboard.

property.name: DrawingContext
property.description: Gets the Drawing tab context.

property.name: IgnoreEvents
property.description: Defines if the application ignores events. Generally, a True value is used in situations where events could create cyclic calls and unintentional loops.

property.name: Layers
property.description: Gets a list of all layers in the current layout.

property.name: LayoutItems
property.description: Gets a list of all layout items in the current layout.

property.name: LayoutModified
property.description: Defines if the current layout has been modified since it was loaded or its last save. LayoutModified acts as a flag for determining if you are prompted to save a layout and the current state of the Save command. The value is set to True when a user makes a change to the current layout using the GUI. A script that makes changes to a layout should set the value to True in order for the application to know whether or not the layout needs to be saved. This is not needed if the script only makes temporary changes to a layout during a simulation.

property.name: LayoutPath
property.description: Gets the local path of current layout. Generally, the path is the same one you would get from the address bar of the File Explorer in Windows. For example, spaces would not be encoded as + signs. See System.Uri.LocalPath in the .NET Framework for more information.

property.name: LayoutUri
property.description: Gets the URI of current layout. The URI would contain its scheme, for example a "file:///" prefix, and spaces would be encoded as + signs. See Example. Print URI of current layout for more information.

property.name: LayoutUriInCompatibilityFormat
property.description: Gets the URI of current layout in a format that was used in older product versions. The URI is similar to LayoutUri. One exception is a forward slash in the URI path is replaced with a backslash.

property.name: Lights
property.description: Gets a list of all lights in the application.

property.name: Materials
property.description: Gets a list of all materials in the application.

property.name: PdfFileName
property.description: Defines the filename for a recorded 3D PDF. (Deprecated) Use the RecordingFileName property.

property.name: PdfRecord
property.description: Defines if a simulation is recorded as a 3D PDF. (Deprecated) Use the Recording property.

property.name: PdfShow
property.description:
Defines if the created 3D PDF is opened after recording a simulation.
(Deprecated) Use the RecordingShow property.

property.name: PdfStepSize
property.description:
Defines the keyframe rate for recording simulations as 3D PDF.
(Deprecated) Use the RecordingFrameRate property.

property.name: ProcessContext
property.description: Gets the Process tab context.

property.name: ProductClass
property.description: Gets the name of the application's product class. Product classes are Creator, Configurator and Viewer.

property.name: ProductKey
property.description: Gets the latest stand-alone key used to activate the application.

property.name: ProductName

The first_tab_caption parameter determines whether a tabbed dialog is used. If first_tab_caption is an empty string, the properties are displayed in a single pane. After the command is executed, the Param_4 property of the command object contains the result of the dialog, as an integer. property.description: Defines if command is checked or visually indicated as active in the GUI, which is only for Python commands.

property.name: Enabled
property.description: Defines if command is enabled/disabled, which is only for Python commands. A False value means the command will be greyed out in the GUI.

property.name: ExecutionType
property.description: Defines how other active commands are managed when executing this command. See Command Constants for more information.

property.name: Icon
property.description: Defines the icon of command in the GUI.

property.name: IgnoreEvents
property.description:
Defines if event passing is ignored when executing command.
This flag is used in situations where events could create cyclic calls.

property.name: IsActive
property.description: Gets the current state of command. A True value means the command is active.

property.name: IsModelingCommand
property.description: Defines if command is used for manipulating geometry and related properties.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of command.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list containing all properties of command. Generally, properties are used to pass information to and from the command implementation for execution.

property.name: Simulation
property.description: Gets the simulation object.

property.name: SupportsOverrideActivation
property.description: Defines if command is restarted after the execution of an override command, which is only for Python commands.

property.name: EyeToMouse
property.description: Gets offset (in World coordinates) from the camera eye point to the pointer on view plane.

property.name: Key
property.description: Gets either the Windows scan code for a pressed key or an offset value for a mouse wheel movement in which a negative value indicates a downward rotation of a mouse wheel.

property.name: MouseOnFloor
property.description: Gets the position of the mouse on the layout floor (ex: Z == 0) in World coordinates.

property.name: MouseOnViewPlane
property.description: Gets the position of the pointer on the view plane in World coordinates.

property.name: ShiftState
property.description: Gets the bit mask indicating which mouse buttons or modifier keys are pressed by a user. There are also bits for single and double click detection. See Command Event Constants more for information.

property.name: Type
property.description: Gets the command event type. See Command Event Constants more for information.

property.name: X
property.description: Gets the X-axis coordinate of pointer in the 3D window.

property.name: Y
property.description: Gets the Y-axis coordinate of pointer in the 3D window.

method.name: addLine
method.description: Creates a new line in set using a list of given points.

method.name: deleteLine
method.description: Deletes a line at a given index from set.

method.name: getLinePointCount
method.description: Returns the number of points in a line at a given index in set.

method.name: getLine
method.description: Returns a list of position vectors for each point of a line at a given index in set.

property.name: CurveData
property.description: Gets the container of mathematical information used for rendering curves.

property.name: Lines
property.description: Gets a list of lines where each line is a list of position vectors for its points.

property.name: LineCount
property.description: Gets the total number of lines in the set.

property.name: LineWidth
property.description: Defines the width of each line in the set.

method.name: clone
method.description: Creates a clone of component in 3D world, and then returns the new component. If shared argument is non-zero the clone and original share geometry. That is, feature tree is shared not copied. This improves performance during simulation, but the cloned components cannot be edited separately (changing the appearance of either clone or original component affects all the others.) Cloning of a component is not allowed when 1) it's not attached to World 2) there is a hierarchy lock in the node tree, which happens during layout loading, or while moving a node from one place to another.

method.name: createProperty
method.description: Adds a new property of a given type and name to component, and then returns the new property. An optional constraints argument can be used to define constraints for new property, which must be defined at the time of creation. See Property Constants for more information.

method.name: deleteProperty
method.description: Deletes a given property from component.

method.name: getPathDistance
method.description: If component is on a path, for example a conveyor path, returns the distance of component on path.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns a property matching a given name in component; otherwise returns None.

method.name: getTransportInfo
method.description:
Returns information about a transport action for a given component.
Generally, a transport action is defined using an Action Container, Python Script and Transport Protocol. See Transportation Constants for information on availability options.

method.name: incrementRevision
method.description: Increments the revision number of a file when using the save() method. The effect is the same as the Increment Revision property in the Credits dialog when saving a file.

method.name: makeUnique
method.description: Makes the feature trees of the component unique, thereby they are not shared with other components.

method.name: save
method.description:
Saves component to file using a given uri.
To save the component with a new VCID, set the VCID property of the component to an empty string.

method.name: saveState
method.description: Saves the current state of component as its initial state.

method.name: startMovement
method.description:
Start the movement of component in a flow, for example a path.
An optional Boolean argument can be used to override flow logic, thereby forcing component to move in flow.

method.name: stopMovement
method.description:
Stops the movement of component in a flow, for example a path.
An optional Boolean argument can be used to override flow logic, thereby forcing component to not move in flow.

method.name: transfer
method.description: Transfers component into a flow and blocks Python execution until completion of transfer. One option allows you to give two separate arguments for a behavior and port. Another option allows you to give a connector for performing transfer. A given behavior must be or derive from vcFlow and you should check for available capacity.
method.parameters: vcBehaviour behaviour, Integer port or vcConnector connector

method.name: transferNonBlocking
method.description: Transfers component into a flow defined by a given behaviour and port without blocking Python execution. That is, call is executed immediately and does not wait for completion of transfer. A given behavior must be or derive from vcFlow and you should check for available capacity.

event.name: OnNodeConfigurationChange
event.description:
Triggered when a change occurs in component node hierarchy.
The node1 and node2 arguments are nodes affected by change. The type argument is the type of change that occurred in component. See Component Constants for more information.
event.parameters: Enumeration type, vcNode node1, vcNode node2

event.name: OnContainerTransition
event.description: Triggered when component enters or exits a vcContainer object. The value argument will be True if component is entering a container; otherwise value is False if component exiting a container.

property.name: BackfaceMode
property.description: Defines the mode for rendering geometry backfaces of component. That is, geometry not facing active camera. See Component Constants for more information.

property.name: BOM
property.description: If a component is included in the bill of materials.

property.name: BOMdescription
property.description: Component description in the bill of materials.

property.name: BOMname
property.description: Component name in the bill of materials.

property.name: Category
property.description: Defines the component group in Cell Graph.

property.name: Container
property.description: Gets the container storing the component. If a component is not stored in a container, the value is None. Note: Container refers to a behavior that can store components, for example a One Way Path.

property.name: CreationTime
property.description: Defines the creation time of component. Generally, creation time is used for gathering statistics about components created during a simulation. In some cases, you might want to edit the creation time of a component for filtering, tracking, assembly and manufacturing purposes.

property.name: IsUnique
property.description: Indicates if the component is sharing its feature trees with other components.

property.name: Locked
property.description: Defines if the component is locked from being edited or manipulated in 3D world.

property.name: Material
property.description: Defines the material of component and any of its features which do not have an assigned material or whose node is set to inherit a material. This material definition is persistent data, meaning that the definition is stored when saving component. Note: Changing the material definition of a component causes all geometries to be rebuilt, which can be a computing intensive operation. For in-simulation visualization purposes, we recommend using the NodeMaterial property instead.

property.name: MovementOrigin
property.description: Defines the offset of component when moving on a path.

property.name: PackFolder
property.description: Gets the mechanism for attaching files to component.

property.name: PathAcceleration
property.description: Defines the acceleration of component when moving on a path.

property.name: PathDeceleration
property.description: Defines the deceleration of component when moving on a path.

property.name: PathVelocity
property.description: Defines the velocity of component when moving on and in the direction of a path. If a zero value, the velocity of the component is defined by the path.

property.name: PDFExportLevel
property.description: Defines the level of detail when exporting component to a 3D PDF. See Component Constants for more information.

property.name: Product
property.description: The Process Modeling product instance linked to this component, if any.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list of all user defined properties in component.

property.name: Uri
property.description: Gets the URI of component

property.name: VCID
property.description: Defines the VCID of component. That is, the unique key identifier of the component. Generally, you should never set this property. Instead, allow the application to generate a VCID when you save the component.

property.name: Visible
property.description: Turns on/off the visibility of component in 3D world.

method.name: connectInternally
method.description: Connects an internal connector at a given index in proxy to a given connector.

method.name: createConnector
method.description: Creates a new connector in proxy. This creates a pair of internal and external connectors.

method.name: deleteConnector
method.description: Deletes a connector at a given index from proxy. This deletes a pair of internal and external connectors.

method.name: getInternalConnector
method.description: Returns an internal connector at a given index in proxy.

method.name: resetConnectorPort
method.description: Resets a connector at a given index in proxy, thereby disconnecting the connector from all of its connections.

property.name: ComponentSignal
property.description: Defines the signal used for signaling what component has been transferred into proxy. This property and PortSignal should be used to determine what and where a component has entered the proxy.

property.name: DynamicConnections
property.description: Defines if the connectors of proxy are dynamic. That is, connections will be established during a simulation by using a Python script or command.

property.name: InternalConnectorCount
property.description: Gets the number of connectors in proxy. An internal connector is always paired with an external connector, so this count will match the count for the proxy's external connectors.

property.name: PortSignal
property.description: Defines the signal used for signaling which connector a component used to enter proxy. The value is the index position of the connector in the proxy's list of connectors.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a new component from template, and then returns the new component. An optional wait argument can be given to use BlockingOptimization. If True, the creator waits for capacity before trying to make a component. If creation fails, returns None. Generally, this occurs when the template is undefined or because of capacity issues. Tip: Set the Limit property to zero in order to disable the internal logic of the creator.

property.name: BlockingOptimization
property.description: Turns on/off the optimization of creator when making new components, thereby improving simulation performance. If True, the creator will not check for capacity rather listen for event. The creator is informed, for example by component or capacity controller, when there is capacity to make a new component.

property.name: Interval
property.description: Defines the interval (in seconds) for creating components.

property.name: Limit
property.description: Defines the maximum number of components that can be created by creator during a simulation.

property.name: Part
property.description: Defines the URI or VCID of template component.

property.name: PartPooling
property.description:
Turns on/off the reuse of components made by the creator, thereby improving simulation performance.
If True, dynamic components removed during simulation are recirculated to make new components, thereby reducing memory allocation. Caution: Be careful when recirculating components that were modified during simulation, for example a change in node material.

property.name: TemplateComponent
property.description: Defines the template used by creator to create new components during a simulation. Either this property or Part can be used to define the template component of creator.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signals the current value of signal to all connected behaviors, thereby triggering the OnSignal event. An optional value argument can be given to set the Value property of the signal.

property.name: Value
property.description: Defines the value of signal. Setting this value does not trigger the OnSignal event unless you use the signal() method.

method.name: new
method.description: Creates a new vcConfigurableProductTypeFilter object and returns the new product type filter.

method.name: bindToStatement
method.description:
Adds the filter properties to the given parentObject. If the filter is already bound, this method first removes the filter properties from the current parent object, and then adds the properties to the new parent object.
To remove the filter properties from the current parent object, set the value of parentObject to None.   startingVarGroup defines the vcProperty.Group value to assign to the first of the properties. The group of the other properties is based on that value. This defines the order of the properties in the Visual Components user interface in relation to the other properties of the parent object.   The default of startingVarGroup value is 10.

property.name: AcceptAllProductTypesProperty
property.description:
Returns True if all product types are accepted.
Returns False if some product types are not accepted.

property.name: AcceptedFlowGroupsProperty
property.description: Returns the list of flow groups (vcProcessFlowGroup) that are accepted.

property.name: AcceptedProductTypesProperty
property.description: Returns the list of product types (vcProductType) that are accepted.

method.name: connect
method.description:
Connects the connector to a given connector.
If no argument is given, this method will remove all connections of the connector.

method.name: testCapacity
method.description: Tests the capacity of connector's behavior. Returns True if not at capacity; otherwise returns False if at full capacity. If the behavior of a connector does not have physical capacity, for example Component Flow Proxy, returns None.

method.name: testConnectedCapacity
method.description:
Tests the capacity of behavior connected to the connector.
Returns True if not at capacity; otherwise returns False if at full capacity. If the behavior of a connector does not have physical capacity, for example Component Flow Proxy, returns None.

property.name: Behaviour
property.description:
Gets the behavior that the connector is connected to in a component.
If no connection, the value is None.

property.name: CapacityTest
property.description: Define the mode for testing capacity before transferring a component to an outgoing connection. See Connector Constants for more information.

property.name: Connection
property.description:
Defines connector that the connector is connected to in a component.
If no connection, the value is None.

property.name: Index
property.description: Gets the position of the connector in its behavior's list of connectors.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of connector.

property.name: Type
property.description: Defines the connector's type. That is, whether the connector is an Input, Output or Input/Output type port. See Connector Constants for more information.

property.name: Capacity
property.description: Defines the maximum number of components that can be stored in the container at any given time. That is, the logical capacity of the container.

property.name: CapacityBlocks
property.description: Defines a list of Capacity Controller type behaviors that globally control the capacity of the container. This property overrides the container's Capacity.

property.name: ComponentCount
property.description: Gets the amount of components stored in the container.

property.name: Components
property.description: Gets a list of components stored in the container.

property.name: ContentVisible
property.description: Sets the visibility of components stored in the container.

property.name: HeadComponent
property.description: Gets a component stored at the head of the container.

property.name: Statistics
property.description: Defines a Statistics behavior that collects data generated by the container during a simulation.

property.name: TailComponent
property.description: Gets a component stored at the tail of the container.

property.name: TransitionSignal
property.description: Defines the signal used for signaling when a component enters/exits the container. A True value means a component has entered the container, whereas a False value means a component has exited the container.

property.name: Id
property.description: Gets the id of the context.

property.name: clearCurves
property.description: Removes all curves from set.

property.name: createCurveNurbs
property.description: Adds a new NURBS to set, and then returns the index of curve in set.
property.access: Integer degree, List of vcVector pts

property.name: createCurvePolyLine
property.description: Adds a new polyline to set, and then returns the index of curve in set.

property.name: createCurveSpline
property.description: Adds a new spline to set, and then returns the index of curve in set.
property.access: Integer degree, List of vcVector pts, List of Integer multiplicities, List of Real knots, List of Real weights

property.name: deleteCurve
property.description: Deletes a curve at a given index in set. Note: Update the scene in order to show visualization changes in the 3D world.

property.name: getCurveEnds
property.description: Returns curve end point information for a curve at a given index in set. The information defines both curve endpoint vectors and their weight values, for example if a NURBS curve is selected.

property.name: getCurveLength
property.description: Returns the length of a curve at a given index in set.

property.name: getCurveMinCurveDistance
property.description: Returns the minimum distance between two curves at given indices in set. The returned value describes the minimum distance between curves and minimum distance between either end points of curves.

property.name: getCurveMinDistance
property.description: Returns the minimum distance of a curve at a given index in set to a given point as well as the length of curve.

property.name: getCurvePoint
property.description: Returns a point on a curve at a given index in set and distance from beginning of curve.

property.name: getCurvePointAndDerivate
property.description: Returns a point and first derivate vector of a curve at a given index in set and distance from beginning of curve.

property.name: getCurvePointCount
property.description: Returns the total number of points for a curve at a given index in set.

property.name: getCurvePositions
property.description: Returns a list of position matrices for each point on a curve at a given index in set.

property.name: getCurveType
property.description: Returns the type of curve at a given index in set. See Topology Constants for more information.

property.name: getPolyLineCurvePoints
property.description: Returns a list of points for a polyline at a given index in set; otherwise returns an empty list.

property.name: getSplineCurveControlPoint
property.description: Returns a list of control points for a spline at a given index in set; otherwise returns an empty list.

property.name: getSplineCurveControlWeights
property.description: Returns a list of control weight values for a spline at a given index in set; otherwise returns an empty list.

property.name: getSplineCurveDegree
property.description: Returns the degree of a spline at a given index in set.

property.name: getSplineCurveKnots
property.description: Returns spline knot multiplicities (knot recurrence) and knot values for a curve at a given index in set.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns the first property matching a given name in the dimension.

property.name: ArrowSize
property.description: Defines the size of the head and tail arrows of dimension.

property.name: Dimension
property.description: Gets the magnitude (distance in millimeters) of dimension.

property.name: Height
property.description: Defines the height of text in dimension.

property.name: LineWidth
property.description: Defines the line width of dimension.

property.name: Location
property.description: Defines the position matrix of the dimension in World coordinate system.

property.name: Material
property.description: Defines the material of dimension.

property.name: Node1
property.description: Defines the node the head of the dimension is attached to in 3D world.

property.name: Node2
property.description: Defines the node the tail of the dimension is attached to in 3D world.

property.name: Position1
property.description: Defines the position matrix of dimension's head relative to Node1 property's coordinate system.

property.name: Position2
property.description: Defines the position matrix of dimension's tail relative to Node2 property's coordinate system.

property.name: Thickness
property.description: Defines the thickness of text in dimension.

property.name: Probability
property.description: Defines the weight of the product type, which is used to calculate the probability for creating product instances of.   It is evaluated as relative to the sum of all configured probabilities like a weight value in a weighted sum. The value must be greater than or equal to zero.

property.name: ProductType
property.description: Defines the product type of entry to create product instances of.

property.name: JointLinkType
property.description: Gets the JointType of the link.

property.name: JointServoType
property.description: Defines whether a joint assigned to a controller is rotational or translational.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of DOF object and joint.

property.name: VALUE
property.description: Defines the current value of the joint.

property.name: Direction
property.description: Gets a vector from the first point to the second point in edge.

property.name: Points
property.description: Gets a list of two points that define the edge.

property.name: Polygons
property.description: Gets a list of polygons that share the edge.

property.name: Type
property.description: Gets the edge type. See Edge Types for more information.

property.name: Condition
property.description: Defines an expression that when evaluated returns a True or False value. A True value means the If statement will execute this scope. A False value means the If statement will not execute this scope.

property.name: Handled
property.description: Defines if this event has already been handled. This is used when an event should only be handled once. All listeners of the event should begin by checking this value before performing any operations. If True, then no further operations should be performed. Otherwise, logic can continue. If the listener then handles this event and no further handling should be done to it, the listener should write True here.

method.name: callRoutine
method.description: Executes a routine. By default, Python execution is suspended until the routine has been completed. An optional suspendScript argument can be given a False value, thereby Python execution continues immediately. An optional clearCallStack argument can be given a False value, thereby the call stack of executor is not cleared before executing routine.
method.parameters: vcRoutine routine, [Boolean suspendScript], [Boolean clearCallStack] or String name, [Boolean suspendScript], [Boolean clearCallStack]

method.name: callStatement
method.description: Executes a statement. By default, Python execution is suspended until the statement has been completed. An optional suspendScript argument can be given a False value, thereby Python execution continues immediately. Note: You can use callStatement() with a process handler to modify the default execution of statements in robot program, for example point-to-point motions, as well as the pre/post execution of statements.

method.name: setOutput
method.description: Sets the value of a signal connected to a port at a given output_index in robot.

method.name: trySetDigitalInputSignals
method.description:
Tries to set the given boolean signal map behavior as the digital input signals.
If setting the behavior is successful, returns True. Otherwise, returns False.

method.name: trySetDigitalOutputSignals
method.description:
Tries to set the given boolean signal map behavior as the digital output signals.
If setting the behavior is successful, returns True. Otherwise, returns False.

method.name: waitInput
method.description: Schedules the executor to wait until a signal connected to a port at a given input_index in robot has a given value. Note: Python execution continues immediately.

event.name: OnCurrentStatementChanged
event.description: Triggered when the current statement of executor changes to a different statement.   (Deprecated) Use OnPreExecuteStatement.

event.name: OnPostExecuteStatement
event.description: Triggered after execution of a statement.

event.name: OnPreExecuteStatement
event.description: Triggered before execution of a statement.   The isImmediate argument defines if the statement will be executed immediately (non time-consuming mode)

event.name: OnProgramFinished
event.description: Triggered when the execution of program has finished.

property.name: Controller
property.description: Defines the controller associated with the executor.

property.name: CurrentStatement
property.description: Gets the statement currently being executed by the executor.

property.name: DigitalInputSignals
property.description: Defines the input signal device associated with the executor.

property.name: DigitalOutputSignals
property.description: Defines the output signal device associated with the executor.

property.name: IsEnabled
property.description: Defines if the program is executed during simulation.

property.name: IsLooping
property.description: Defines if the executor loops its program.

property.name: ProcessHandlers
property.description:
Defines a list of process handlers for overriding or modifying statements of robot program and executing process statements.
(Deprecated) Use StatementHandler.

property.name: Program
property.description: Gets the program associated with the executor.

property.name: StatementHandler
property.description: Defines a process handler for controlling the execution of statements in robot program. See an example of modifying a point-to-point motion statement. Important: Process statements and Path statements with assigned process handlers are executed by their handlers. That is, those statements are not passed on to the statement handler of executor. Do not call nor try to execute them with the statement handler.

property.name: UseExternalExecutor
property.description: Defines if the component is controlled by external execution mechanism, for example a virtual robot controller.

method.name: attach
method.description: Attaches a given feature to this feature, thereby allowing you to reorder the containing node's feature tree. The given feature cannot be the root feature or parent of this feature. An optional rebuild argument can be used to control the rebuilding of geometry for an attached feature. Default is False value and will not rebuild geometry, whereas a True value will rebuild geometry. Returns True if attachment is successful; otherwise returns False.

method.name: clone
method.description: Copies the feature to the same level in containing node's feature tree, and then returns the clone.

method.name: collapse
method.description: Collapses the feature into a new Geometry feature. The original feature will be deleted, thereby you need to get handle for the new feature.

method.name: createFeature
method.description:
Adds a new feature of a given type and name as a child of this feature.
See Feature Constants for more information.

method.name: createProperty
method.description: Adds a new property of a given type and name to the feature. An optional constraints argument can be given to define constraints for the new property, which must be done at the time of creation. See Property Constants for more information.

method.name: delete
method.description: Deletes the feature and its subfeatures, and then returns True; otherwise returns False.

method.name: deleteProperty
method.description: Deletes a given property from the feature.

method.name: getFeature
method.description: Returns the feature.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns a property of the feature that matches the given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the feature and its subfeature tree.

property.name: Children
property.description: Gets a list of feature's immediate child features.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of feature.

property.name: NodePositionMatrix
property.description: Gets the position matrix of the feature relative to its node's coordinate system.

property.name: Parent
property.description: Gets the parent of this feature in the node feature tree. If the feature is root feature, return value is None.

property.name: PhysicsCollider
property.description: Defines the type of collider used by the feature for physics.

property.name: PositionMatrix
property.description: Defines the position matrix of this feature relative to its parent feature's coordinate system.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list of all properties in feature.

property.name: Type
property.description: Gets the feature type. See Feature Constants for more information.

property.name: Visible
property.description: Turns on/off the visibility of the frame in the 3D world.

setGroup
new

property.description: Specifies ProcessFlowStep

property.name: Group
property.description: Specifies vcProcessGroup object. In case a custom ID is used for GroupId, this will be None.

property.name: CapacityAvailable

property.name: ConnectorCount

property.name: Connectors
property.description: Gets a list of connectors in flow object.

property.name: Statistics
property.description: Defines a Statistics behavior that collects data generated by this flow during a simulation.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns a property of the vcStepProcessConfiguration.

property.name: ProcessGroup
property.description: The process groups this configuration is applied to.

property.name: IsOptional
property.description: Defines whether ProcessGroup is optional inside a vcFlowStep.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets the properties of this vcStepProcessConfiguration.

property.name: FramePositionMatrix
property.description: Gets the position matrix of frame.

property.name: OriginalFramePositionMatrix
property.description: Gets the original position matrix of frame.

method.name: createFrame

method.name: deleteFrame
method.description: Deletes a frame at a given index from set.

method.name: getFrame
method.description: Returns the position matrix of a frame at a given index in set.

method.name: setFrame
method.description: Sets the position matrix of a frame at a given index in set.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates all frames in set, thereby updating the set's bound box.

property.name: FrameCount
property.description: Gets the number of frames in set.

property.name: AxisTextVisible
property.description:
Turns on/off the display of axis labels for Frame features in set. That is, XYZ labels for coordinate axes in a Frame feature.

property.name: ConnectingLinesVisible
property.description: Defines if lines are drawn in the 3D world between each Frame feature in set. The line type is defined by the LineDisplayMode property.

property.name: CustomIcon
property.description: Defines the name of a vc3DIcon object used for rendering each Frame feature in set. Other properties determine if and how a 3D icon is used with the set.

property.name: FixedSize
property.description: Defines if CustomIcon is scaled to have a constant size relative to a user's 3D world view. This property is enabled when FrameDisplayMode is set to use icons and FramesVisible is set to True.

property.name: FrameDisplayMode
property.description: Defines the mode for rendering Frame features in set. This property is disabled if FramesVisible is set to False. See Frame Display Mode Constants for more information.

property.name: FramesVisible
property.description: Turns on/off the display of Frame features in set.

property.name: LineDisplayMode
property.description: Defines the mode for rendering lines between Frame features in set. This property is disabled if ConnectingLinesVisible is set to False. See Line Display Mode Constants for more information.

property.name: LoopLines
property.description: Defines if a line is drawn to connect the first and last Frame feature in set. This property is disabled if ConnectingLinesVisible is set to False.

property.name: Material
property.description: Defines the material of Frame features in set. This might be overridden by the material of CustomIcon or an individual Frame feature.

property.name: NamesVisible
property.description: Defines if the name of each Frame feature in set is displayed in the 3D world. This property is disabled if FramesVisible is set to False. Note: Displaying the names of Frame features can slow performance and degrade usability when a large amount of Frame features are contained in a small area.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all geometry sets from container.

method.name: cloneGeometrySets
method.description:
Copies all geometry sets in the container to a given container.
An optional offset argument can be given to offset the copied geometry, thereby making it easier to distinguish the original from its copy. In this case, geometry is shared between both containers.

method.name: createGeometrySet
method.description: Creates a new geometry set of a given type in container. See Geometry Constants for more information.

method.name: deleteGeometrySet
method.description: Deletes a given geometry set or one at a given index from container.

method.name: getGeometrySet
method.description: Returns a geometry set at a given index in container.

method.name: moveGeometrySets
method.description:
Moves all geometry sets in the container to a given container.
An optional offset argument can be given to offset the moved geometry, for example to apply a node offset. In this case, geometry is not shared between both containers since the original container is now empty.

method.name: setModified
method.description: Marks the geometry of container as being modified, thereby alerting the application that changes need to be saved to file.

method.name: transformContent
method.description: Transforms all geometry sets of container by the given matrix.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the bound box of container.

property.name: BoundCenter
property.description: Gets a vector from the origin to the center of the container's bound box.

property.name: BoundDiagonal
property.description: Gets a half diagonal vector from the center to an upper corner of the container's bound box using positive axis directions.

property.name: GeometrySetCount
property.description: Gets the amount of geometry sets in container.

property.name: GeometrySets
property.description: Gets a list of geometry sets in container.

method.name: makeUnique
method.description: Makes the feature and its geometry unique, thereby the geometry is not shared with other features. (Deprecated) Use the makeUnique() method in vcComponent.

property.name: AmbientOcclusion
property.description: Defines if geometry supporting ambient occlusion is rendered in the 3D world. 0 VC_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION_NONE 1 VC_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION_VERTEX

property.name: CreaseAngle
property.description: Defines an angle tolerance for smoothing surfaces based on camera angle and lighting calculations. For example, if the angle between edges of a surface is less than CreaseAngle, the affected triangle sets will appear as one smooth face.

property.name: Geometry
property.description: Gets the container of feature's geometry.

property.name: IsUnique
property.description: Indicates if the feature and its geometry is unique or shared with other features. (Deprecated) Use the IsUnique property in vcComponent.

property.name: Pickable
property.description: Turns on/off the ability to select geometry of feature in the 3D world. Note: This affects all commands and tools that use snap types.

property.name: ShowContent
property.description: Turns on/off the visibility of feature.

property.name: ShowBackfaces
property.description: Turns on/off the rendering of geometry in the feature that is not facing the camera of the 3D world.

property.name: TesselationQuality
property.description:
Defines the quality of feature's geometry by affecting both angle and chord height tolerances used for tessellating the feature.
Note: This property does not set any fractional tolerance values as it relates to the degree of accuracy.

property.name: Uri
property.description:
Defines the URI of source file for geometry used in feature.
Writing this property will override any existing geometry in the feature and cannot be undone.

method.name: updateBoundIncrementally
method.description: Increments the bound box of the set's component.
method.parameters: Real x, Real y, Real z or vcVector vector

property.name: Billboard
property.description:
Defines if geometry of set is always facing the 3D world camera.
Generally, this property is used for billboard text and is only supported for the following types: vcCompactLineSet vcPointSet vcText2DSet vcTriangleSet

property.name: BoundCenter
property.description: Gets a vector from the origin to the center of the container's bound box.

property.name: BoundDiagonal
property.description: Gets a half diagonal vector from the center to an upper corner of the container's bound box using positive axis directions.

property.name: Container
property.description: Gets the geometry container of set.

property.name: Feature
property.description: Gets the feature that the set belongs to in node feature tree.

property.name: FixedSize
property.description: Defines if the size of set visually remains the same in the 3D world regardless of camera position. This property is only supported for the following types: vcCompactLineSet vcPointSet vcText2DSet vcTriangleSet

property.name: HasMaterialInheritance
property.description: Determines if the geometry set has material inheritance (geo set will use the inherited material or its own).

property.name: Layer
property.description: Defines the layer that the set belongs to in layout.

property.name: LightAmbientTexture
property.description: Defines if the material texture of set is used to affect ambient light intensity and shininess of surfaces. (Deprecated)

property.name: LightAmbientVertex
property.description: Defines if vertex color/intensity is blended with light rays to render ambient lighting effect. (Deprecated)

property.name: Material
property.description: Defines the material of set. If None, the set uses default render settings.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of set.

property.name: Type
property.description: Gets the set type. See Geometry Constants for more information.

property.name: UseBackface
property.description: Defines if geometry of set is rendered when not facing the 3D world camera.

property.name: VertexColor
property.description: Defines if the set uses vertex coloring. See Geometry Constants for more information.

method.name: addElseIfScope
method.description: Adds vcElseIfScope to the statement and returns that scope. The default value of index is -1, so a new vcElseIfScope is inserted immediately before ElseScope.

method.name: deleteElseIfScope
method.description: Deletes given scope from the statement.

property.name: Condition
property.description: Defines an expression that when evaluated returns a True or False value. A True value means the statement will execute its ThenScope of statements. A False value means the statement will execute its ElseScope of statements.

property.description: Gets the scope of statements executed by the statement if Condition is true.

property.name: ElseIfScopes
property.description: Gets a list of ElseIfScopes in the statement.

property.name: ElseScope
property.description: Gets the scope of statements executed by the statement if Condition is false.

method.name: signal

property.name: Value
property.description: Defines the value of signal. Setting this value does not trigger the OnSignal event unless you use the signal() method.

event.name: OnInteraction
event.description: Triggered when user interaction occurs for a given command and type of event. See Interactive Constants for more information.

method.name: getPortName

method.name: input

method.name: setPortName

event.name: OnSignalTrigger
event.description: Triggered when the value of a signal mapped to a port has a new value.

property.name: Listeners
property.description: Defines a list of behaviors using the signal map.

property.name: PortCount
property.description: Defines the amount of ports in signal map.

property.name: IsSystem
property.description: Always returns True

method.name: inverse
method.description: Calculates the joint values of robot for a given target and list of joint values. An optional fixed argument can be given to identify fixed joints in the robot. The returned value will identify joint values of robot and status of solution to target. See Solution Constants for more information.
