property.name: ForwardKin
property.description: Defines the function for forward kinematics calculation. If None, uses built-in method.

property.name: FractionalStep
property.description: Defines the fractional step of calculation. The default value is 0.5.

property.name: IgnoreOrientation
property.description: Turns on/off the calculation of orientation. The default value is False in which orientation is calculated for solution. Generally, a True value would be used when orientation is not important, for example with Cartesian robots.

property.name: JacobianJointCount
property.description: Defines the number of joints in calculation.

property.name: NumIterationsInner
property.description: Defines the number of iterations for calculating inner product.

property.name: NumIterationsOuter
property.description: Defines the number of iterations for calculating outer product.

property.name: OrientationMaxStep
property.description: Defines the max step for orientation in calculation.

property.name: OrientationTolerance
property.description: Defines the tolerance for orientation in calculation.

property.name: PositionalMaxStep
property.description: Defines the max step for position in calculation.

property.name: PositionalTolerance
property.description: Defines the tolerance for position in calculation.

property.name: RotationalJointStepSize
property.description: Defines the step for rotational joint values in calculation.

event.name: OnInteract
event.description: Triggered when user interaction occurs with an object defined by a Jog Info behavior. The type argument is the Jog Info behavior of the object. The cursor_action argument is the type of mouse action that occurs in the jog area. 0 Hover in. 1 Click or drag 2 Hover out The data argument provides a list of jog info that includes command event data and XY coordinates (in pixels) where interaction occurs on the viewport.
event.parameters: vcBehaviour type, Enumeration cursor_action, List of jog info (vcCommandEvent type-shiftstate, Boolean mouseclicked, [not used], Integer Xposition, Integer Yposition, vcVector floor, vcVector view, vcVector direction, vcVector hitposition) data

property.name: Controller
property.description: Gets the controller of joint. If joint is not driven by controller, value is None.

property.name: CurrentValue
property.description: Defines the joint's value.

property.name: Dof
property.description: Gets the Dof object of joint.

property.name: ExternalController
property.description: Gets the external controller of joint. If joint is not driven by an external controller, value is None.

property.name: InitialValue
property.description: Defines the initial value of joint. That is, the initial state of the joint.

property.name: LagTime
property.description: Defines the lag time (in seconds) of joint.

property.name: MaxAcceleration
property.description: Defines the maximum acceleration (units/degrees per second squared) of joint.

property.name: MaxDeceleration
property.description: Defines the maximum deceleration (units/degrees per second squared) of joint.

property.name: MaxSpeed
property.description: Defines the maximum speed (units/degrees per second squared) of joint.

property.name: MaxValue
property.description: Defines an expression that when evaluated returns the maximum value of joint.

property.name: MinValue
property.description: Defines an expression that when evaluated returns the minimum value of joint.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the joint's name.

property.name: SettleTime
property.description: Defines the settle time (in seconds) of joint.

property.name: Type
property.description: Defines the joint type. See Joint Constants for more information.

method.name: createJacobian
method.description: Creates a new Jacobian matrix object for calculating inverse and forward kinematics solutions.

method.name: createProperty
method.description:
Adds a new property of a given type and name to the kinematics object.
An optional constraints argument can be given to define constraints for the new property, which must be defined at the time of creation. See Property Constants for more information.

method.name: getJointMoveDist
method.description: Returns the distance a joint at a given index must move in order to reach a given value.

method.name: getJointMoveTo
method.description: Indicates whether a joint at a given index can move to a given value. Returns True and the given value if joint can reach target. Otherwise, returns False and the amount exceeding the joint's limits.

method.name: moveJointTo
method.description: Drives a joint at a given index to a given value. Returns True if joint reached target; otherwise returns False.

property.name: CustomData
property.description: Defines an instance of a user-defined class, thereby allowing you to implement custom properties and methods for the kinematics object.

property.name: JointCount
property.description: Gets the joint count of the kinematics object.

property.name: JointMaxLimits
property.description: Gets the maximum value for each joint of the kinematics object.

property.name: JointMinLimits
property.description: Gets the minimum value for each joint of the kinematics object.

property.name: JointsRotational
property.description:
Gets the joint type for each joint of the kinematics object.
A True value indicates a rotational joint.

property.name: JointValues
property.description: Defines the joint values of the kinematics object.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets the dynamic properties of the kinematics object.

property.name: SecondaryJointValues
property.description: Defines the external joint values of the kinematics object.

property.name: Solutions
property.description: Defines a list of possible solutions for the kinematics object and its Target. Generally, the format of a solution is a configuration warning followed by joint values for the motion target. See Solution Constants for more information.

property.name: Target
property.description: Defines the motion target of the kinematics object.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of layer.

property.name: Visibility
property.description: Turns on/off the visibility of layer and all of its objects.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the item in its layout.

property.name: IsPersistent
property.description: Defines if the item is saved with layout.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of item.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list of all properties for item.

property.name: Type
property.description: Defines the item type. See Layout Item Constants for more information.

property.name: PackFolder
property.description: Gets the mechanism for attaching files to component.

property.name: createProperty
property.description: Adds a new property of a given type and name to the layout item. An optional constraints argument can be given to define constraints for the new property, which must be defined at the time of creation. See Property Constants for more information.

property.name: deleteProperty
property.description: Deletes a given property from the item.

property.name: getProperty
property.description: Returns a property of the item that matches the given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: DataCount
method.description: Gets the number of records in schema.

method.name: FrameColorSchemaIndex
method.description:
Defines the index of schema property used for coloring frame.
The schema property should be a vector data type.

method.name: FrameDataSchemaIndex
method.description: Defines the index of schema property used for positional data of record. Generally, the schema property is a matrix data type. The positional data is used for visualizing record as a Frame feature in 3D world.

method.name: FrameNameColorSchemaIndex
method.description: Defines the index of schema property used for coloring the label of frame. The schema property should be a vector data type.

method.name: FrameNameSchemaIndex
method.description: Defines the index of schema property used for labeling the Frame feature of record in 3D world. The schema property should be a string data type. The default is -1. This means the Frame feature of record will not be labeled with its custom name rather the number of record in schema.

method.name: FrameNameVisibleSchemaIndex
method.description: Defines the index of schema property used for controlling the visibility of label of record in 3D world. The schema property should be a Boolean data type. The default is -1. This means labels are visible.

method.name: FrameVisibleSchemaIndex
method.description: Defines the index of schema property used for controlling the visibility of Frame feature of record in 3D world. The schema property should be a Boolean data type. This also affects the visibility of label of record in 3D world.

method.name: LineDisplaySchemaIndex
method.description: Define the index of schema property used for the position of record in 3D world.   This allows you to connect positions with a line generated in 3D world.

method.name: Node
method.description: Defines a node the Frame features of records are attached to in 3D world. In some cases, this might be the simulation root node/World node. In other cases, this might be the root node of a workpiece.

method.name: PositionMatrix
method.description: Defines an offset for position of record in 3D world. The offset is based in coordinate system of Node property. Generally, an offset is applied to compensate for weld torch flares or to adjust position based on Z-axis direction of robot TCP.

method.name: SchemaProperties
method.description: Gets a list of all schema properties in the layout item. Note: This does not include data values for each record in the schema.

method.name: clearSchema
method.description: Empties the schema, thereby removing all schema properties and setting the data count to zero.

method.name: cloneSchemaObject
method.description: Clones a set of records in a given range. The from_dataindex argument defines the first record in range. The count argument defines how many records to clone. The to_dataindex argument defines where to insert the copies. Warning: Currently, you cannot append cloned records to the end of the table. You must insert the copies before an existing record.
method.parameters: Integer from_dataindex, Integer count, Integer to_dataindex

method.name: createProperty
method.description: Adds a new property of a given type and name to the layout item. An optional constraints argument can be given to define constraints for the new property, which must be defined at the time of creation. See Property Constants for more information.

method.name: createSchemaProperty
method.description: Adds a new schema property of a given type and name to the layout item. See Property Constants for more information.

method.name: deleteProperty
method.description: Deletes a given property of the layout item.

method.name: deleteSchemaObject
method.description: Deletes a set of records in a given range. The from_dataindex argument defines the first record in range. The count argument defines how many records to delete.

method.name: deleteSchemaProperty
method.description: Deletes a given property that is a schema property of the layout item.

method.description: Returns the value of a data field at a given dataindex and itemindex.

method.name: getDataValues
method.description: Returns the values of a record at a given dataindex.

method.description: Returns a property of the layout item that matches the given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: getSchemaProperty
method.description: Returns a schema property of the layout item that matches the given name; otherwise returns None.

method.name: setDataValue
method.description: Sets the value of a data field at a given dataindex and itemindex. Note: The value argument can be a vcProperty object, thereby the value of that property is passed to the data field.

method.name: setDataValues
method.description: Sets all values for schema properties of a record at a given dataindex. The values argument must be a tuple with the same amount of elements as there are schema properties. Each element's value must be a supported data type and match the type of the corresponding schema property; otherwise the data field will not reference the new value. Note: An element of a tuple given as the values argument can be a vcProperty object, thereby the value of that property is passed to the data field.
method.parameters: Integer dataindex, Integer itemindex, n-tuple of <Type> values

method.name: updateData
method.description: Allocates the size of the schema to support a potential amount of elements/entries for schema properties based on the given count. Note: The allocation is optional as size is updated automatically based on number of entries.

property.name: ColorMask
property.description:

property.description: Turns on/off the use of stippling in the material to create light and dark shades based on point density.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of material.

property.name: OpacityType
property.description: Defines the opacity type used by material. See Material Constants for more information.

method.name: createTarget

If motiontype argument is VC_MOTIONTARGET_MT_JOINT, speed argument defines JointSpeedFactor (mm/s) property of motion target. See vcRslMotionStatement and vcMotionTarget for more information.

property.name: Targets
property.description: Lists all motion targets in the interpolator.

event.name: OnMotionChanged
event.description: Triggered when the state of a component's motion changes on a path. If the state of a path is changed so that it affects the motion of all components on that path, this event is called for each of those components. See Path Motion State Constants for more information.

event.name: OnPhysicalTransition
event.description: Triggered when either a) the leading edge of a component enters path or b) the trailing edge of a component exits path. The Container argument is the current container of the component given in the Component argument, which may not be the container of component at the time of the call since the component may have transitioned elsewhere. The arrive_leave argument is True if component is entering path; otherwise False means a component is exiting path.
event.parameters: vcContainer Container, vcComponent Component, Boolean arrive_leave

property.name: Acceleration
property.description: Defines rate of acceleration (mm/s^2) for components moving on path. If zero, acceleration is not calculated.

property.name: Accumulate
property.description: Turns on/off pile-up of components moving on path. If True, components on the path stop moving when they encounter a blocked component. If False, components on the path stop moving when a component is blocked from exiting the path.

property.name: Deceleration
property.description: Defines rate of deceleration (mm/s^2) for components moving on path. If zero, deceleration is not calculated.

property.name: DetailCurveMotion
property.description: Turns on/off detailed movement of components to and from path, for example when moving from linear path to curved path. If True, bound box of component is used to avoid intersecting with other components. This might create a gap between components, for example components that are cylindrical. This also decreases simulation performance. You can disable DetailCurveMotion if components are cylindrical or if a slight intersection between components when transferring from linear to curved path is not a concern.

property.name: Direction
property.description: Defines the direction components move on path, but only if the path supports two or more directions. See Conveyor Direction Constants for more information.

property.name: FastScheduling
property.description: Turns on/off the optimization of moving components on the path. If True, the path limits the amount of generated events, thereby improving simulation performance. If False, the path moves components at shorter increments, thereby increasing the amount of events and decreasing simulation performance.

property.name: Interpolation
property.description: Defines mode used by path to interpolate its waypoints set in Path property. See Conveyor Interpolation Mode Constants for more information.

property.name: Path
property.description: Defines an ordered list of Frame features referenced as waypoints of path. If set, path is calculated based on its interpolation mode.

property.name: PathAxis
property.description: Defines mode for calculating how much space a component occupies on path, thereby allowing the path to utilize its space and determine if one or more components are blocked if SpaceUtilization property is set to True. See Path Axis Mode Constants for more information.

property.name: PathLength
property.description: Gets the length of path. That is, the distance from first to last waypoint along the path.

property.name: RetainOffset
property.description: Defines if a component entering, placed or grabbed by the path is snapped to and aligned with path's axis. If True, a component retains its offset while moving on path. If False, component is snapped to nearest point on path and its origin is aligned with calculated path.

property.name: SegmentSize
property.description: Defines the size of segments when path uses segmentation to move components to and from different sections of the path. If value is greater than zero, the number of path segments is calculated in order to determine the capacity of each segment based on total capacity of path. Therefore, components move on path based on the capacity of a proceeding segment.

property.name: Sensors
property.description: List of sensors connected to path, which must be either component path or process point type sensors.

property.name: SpaceUtilization
property.description: Defines if components accumulating on path are kept separate from one another and how new components enter path. If False, components may overlap one another and/or pile up side by side, which might be useful if RetainOffset is set to True.

property.name: Speed
property.description: Defines the speed (mm/s) of path.

property.name: AccuracyMethod
property.description: Defines the zone of accuracy type to use for the target, for example distance, time or velocity. See Motion Target Constants for more information.

property.name: AccuracyValue
property.description: Defines the limit used in AccuracyMethod.

property.name: Base
property.description: Defines the base frame used by robot for the statement.

property.name: CycleTime
property.description: Defines the total elapsed time (in seconds) for executing motion statement, which may scale speed and acceleration of joints. If zero, CycleTime is ignored.

property.name: ExternalTCP
property.description: Defines the interpolation mode for targeting motion. 0 = False Default setting that uses Base to Tool configuration; position created at tool frame. 1 = True Interpolation from Tool to Base; position created at base frame.

property.name: Tool
property.description: Defines the tool frame used by robot for the statement.

method.name: getConfigWarning
method.description: Tests a robot configuration for any potential issues associated with target. The returned value indicates singularity (S), joint limits (J) and unreachable (U) errors using a format of SJU. 0 = 000 No errors. 1 = 001 Reachability error in robot. 2 = 010 One or more joints exceeding limits. 3 = 011 Reachability and joint limit errors. 4 = 100 Singularity detected, for example in articulated robot wrist. 5 = 101 Singularity and reachability errors. 6 = 110 Singularity and joint limit errors. 7 = 111 Singularity, joint limit and reachability errors. See Motion Target Constants for more information.

method.name: getConfigWarnings
method.description: Tests all configurations in kinematic structure for potentials errors related to target. See getConfigWarning() method for more information on possible returned values.

property.name: OrientationInterpolationMode

property.name: PositionerIndex

property.name: UseJoints

property.description:
If Distribution type property, defines an expression to use for calculating values.
Available functions include: normal( u, s ) Normal distribution for mean value u, and the standard deviation s. lognormal( u, s ) Log normal distribution for mean u, and the standard deviation s. uniform( a, b ) Uniform distribution in range a <= x < b. exponential( lambda ) Exponential distribution where the mean is 1/lambda and the variance is 1/lambda^2. gamma( k, theta ) Gamma distribution with shape k and scale theta. triangular( min, mode, max ) Triangular distribution with the specified minimum, mode and maximum values. weibull( k, lambda ) Weibull distribution with shape k and scale lambda. Tip: Use RandomStream to have the distribution use a stream for seeding a value and generating the same set of random numbers during a simulation. That is, if you reset and run a simulation you should expect the same values given in the previous simulation.

event.name: OnCalculateTarget
event.description: Triggered when a motion target is being calculated, thereby allowing you to edit the motion target that will be passed to OnInverse event. The fullTarget argument is the target matrix calculated from either World origin or Robot World Frame to TCP. The baseFrame and toolFrame arguments define the base and tool frames used for motion target. The targetInverted argument can be used to reverse the target's calculation, for example from TCP to base frame. Generally, you should use OnCalculateTarget for robots that have less than six degrees of freedom to remove potential effects caused by a tool offset.
event.parameters: vcMatrix fullTarget, vcMatrix baseFrame, vcMatrix toolFrame, Boolean targetInverted

event.name: OnConstrainParams
event.description: Triggered when the joint configuration of a robot or motion target is being interpolated and requires joint limits to determine valid kinematic solutions. Generally, you use OnConstrainParams to avoid potential joint limit errors and narrow possible solutions for a joint motion target. For example, you can specify the limits of a joint for certain types of movements. The return value should be a Boolean.

event.name: OnFinalize
event.description: Triggered when layout or component is being loaded in 3D world. The event occurs, for example, when copying a component, or loading a layout of components. The event is triggered before the needed components are attached to the 3D world. Generally, you use OnFinalize to set the joint initial position of a robot or any necessary implementation that uses kinematics.

event.name: OnForward
event.description:
Triggered when a motion target is calculated using joint values.
Return a Boolean value to enable or disable forward kinematics.

event.name: OnGetConfigurationCount
event.description: Triggered when the configuration count of a robot is requested by the kinematics solver. If configuration properties are dynamically changing, this event must be implemented and return a constant integer value, which overrides the default count defined in the OnInitKinObject event. Important: If OnGetConfigurationCount is used, you need to implement the OnGetCurrentConfiguration and OnSetCurrentConfiguration events.

event.name: OnGetCurrentConfiguration
event.description: Triggered when the current configuration of a robot is requested by its kinematics solver. If this event is implemented, you should read the robot's configurations property list, and then return the currently selected index position (integer). That value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the value returned by the OnGetConfigurationCount event. Important: If OnGetCurrentConfiguration is used, you need to implement the OnGetConfigurationCount and OnSetCurrentConfiguration events.

event.name: OnGetJointCount
event.description: Triggered when the joint count of a robot is requested by the kinematics solver. In most cases, you should the total joint count as an integer.

event.name: OnGetJointName
event.description: Triggered when the name of a joint at a given index is requested by kinematics solver. The return value should be a string.

event.name: OnGetKinematicJointCount
event.description: Triggered when the actual number of kinematic joints used in forward kinematics is requested by kinematics solver. Generally, additional helper joints are needed for interpolating redundant solutions. The return value should be an integer.

event.name: OnGetSecondaryJointCount
event.description: Triggered when the external joint count of a robot is requested by kinematics solver. In most cases, you should return the total joint count as an integer value.

event.name: OnGetSecondaryJointName
event.description: Triggered when the name of an external joint at a given index is requested by kinematics solver. The return value should be a string.

event.name: OnInitKinObject
event.description: Triggered when a new instance of vcKinObject is created, thereby allowing you to access and edit the kinematics object of a component. Generally, you use OnInitKinObject to add new properties and define initial values for a kinematics object.

event.name: OnInverse
event.description:
Triggered when the joint values of a motion target need to be calculated and given as a solution for the kinematics object.
Return a Boolean value to enable or disable inverse kinematics.

event.name: OnRebuild
event.description: Triggered when the kinematics object is rebuilt, thereby updating changes made to its properties.

event.name: OnRelaxParams
event.description: Triggered when possible solutions for a motion target are being calculated by kinematics solver. Generally, you use OnRelaxParams to allow for all possible solutions, even those which exceed joint limits. For example, you might want to force a robot motion with potential risks such as singularity or Gimbal lock.

event.name: OnSetCurrentConfiguration
event.description: Triggered when the configuration of a robot is needed for a kinematic solution. If this event is implemented, you should set the robot's configurations property list based on the given configurationIndex. Important: If OnSetCurrentConfiguration is used, you need to implement the OnGetConfigurationCount and OnGetCurrentConfiguration events.

event.name: OnUpdateSecondaryJoints
event.description: Triggered when external joint values need to be recalculated for motion target updates. The return value should be a Boolean.

method.description: Connects signals. The default value of the connect_in_gui is True, which means the created connection will be visible in GUI. If a False value is given, the created connection won't be visible in GUI. Because of this, use the False value only when necessary!

method.name: disconnect
method.description: Disconnects signals. The default value of the disconnect_in_gui is True, which means the signal is disconnected also in GUI. If the signals were connected using the connect method with a False argument in the connect_in_gui, they should be disconnected using a False argument in the disconnect_in_gui

event.name: OnValueChange
event.description: Triggered when the value of signal is changed, thereby signaling all Connections of new value.

property.name: AutomaticReset
property.description: Turns on/off the reset of signal to initial value when simulation is reset.

property.name: Connections
property.description: Defines a list of behaviors connected to signal.

method.name: canConnect
method.description: Returns True if a given interface can connect to the interface; otherwise, returns False.

method.name: connect
method.description: Connects a given interface to the interface.   An optional retain_offset argument can be used to retain the offset when attaching component to another using Hierarchy field.   If connection is successful, returns True; otherwise returns False.

method.name: createSection
method.description: Adds a new section of a given name to interface, and then returns the new section.

method.name: deleteSection
method.description: If one-to-one interface, deletes a section at a given index from interface. Returns True is deletion is successful; otherwise returns False.

method.name: overrideEventResult
method.description: Overrides event result to have a given result.

method.name: unConnect
method.description: (Deprecated) Use disconnect().

method.name: disconnect
method.description: Removes all connections in interface. An optional other_interface argument can be used to disconnect a specific interface from the interface, for example when interface is one-to-many. Returns True if disconnection is successful; otherwise returns None.

event.name: OnConnect
event.description: Triggered when interface is connected to another interface.

event.name: OnDisconnect
event.description: Triggered when interface is disconnected from another interface.

event.name: OnMatch
event.description: Triggered when interfaces are tested as being able to connect to one another.

event.name: OnUnConnect
event.description: (Deprecated) Use OnDisconnect.

property.name: AngleTolerance
property.description: Defines an angle tolerance for allowing interfaces to connect to the interface when not aligned on same axis.

property.name: ConnectedComponent
property.description: Gets the component connected to interface. If no connection, value is None.

property.name: ConnectedComponents
property.description: If one-to-many interface, gets a list of all components connected to interface. If no connection, value is an empty list.

property.name: ConnectedFromSections
property.description: If one-to-many interface, gets a list of all sections in interface that have an active connection. If no connection, value is an empty list.

property.name: ConnectedSection
property.description: If one-to-one interface, gets a section of interface that have an active connection. (Deprecated)

property.name: DistanceTolerance
property.description: Defines the distance at which the interface snaps to an available connection, thereby completing Plug and Play.

property.name: ConnectedSections
property.description: If one-to-many interface, gets a list of all sections in interface that have an active connection. (Deprecated)

property.name: ConnectedToSections
property.description: Gets a list of sections connected to interface. If no connection, value is an empty list.

property.name: ConnectionEditName
property.description: Defines the name of a Button property to temporarily create in component for connecting the interface. If an empty string, button is not created and/or removed from GUI. The string can use format [tab name]::[button name] to list button in a specific tab. If tab does not exist, it will be automatically created to contain button as long as string refers to that tab. If tab name is not given, button is listed as a default property.

property.name: IsAbstract
property.description: Defines if interface supports remote connections.

property.name: IsConnected
property.description: If True, interface is connected; otherwise interface is not connected.

property.name: Sections
property.description: Gets a list of all sections in interface. If no sections, value is an empty list.

property.name: Index
property.description: Defines the index of field in section. Important: The order of fields in a section is evaluated when establishing a connection between sections. For example, sections may have compatible fields but cannot connect because the order of fields differ in each section.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of field.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list of all properties in the field.

property.name: Section
property.description: Gets the section of field.

property.name: Type
property.description: Gets the field type. See Interface Constants for more information.

method.name: createField
method.description: Creates a new field of a given type and name in section, and then returns the new field. See Interface Constants for more information.

method.name: deleteField

property.name: ConnectedToSection
property.description: Gets a section connected to the section. If section is not connected, value is None.

property.name: Fields
property.description: Gets a list of all fields in section.

property.name: Frame
property.description: If belonging to physical interface, defines the Frame feature referenced as the location of section.

property.name: Index
property.description: Defines the index of section in interface.

property.name: Interface
property.description: Gets the interface of section.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of section.

method.name: autoHalt
method.description: Stops a simulation if there is no active component running a script that generates simulation events, and then returns True.

method.name: continueRun
method.description: Continues running a simulation with a 10 day runtime or a given amount of time.

method.name: halt
method.description: Stops a simulation immediately.

method.name: newCollisionDetector
method.description: Creates a new collision detector in 3D world, and then returns the new detector.

method.name: newVolumeDetector
method.description: Creates a new volume detector in 3D world, and then returns the new detector.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets simulation and static components to initial state and sets simulation clock at zero.

method.name: restoreInitialState
method.description: Restores simulation and static components to initial state.

method.name: run
method.description: Runs simulation with a 10 day runtime or a given amount of time.

method.name: setInitialState
method.description: Saves the current state of simulation and static components.

method.name: setFastScheduling
method.description: Updates the fast scheduling flag for all conveyors that support the property.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates simulation and 3D world to reflect current state of components.

event.name: OnCollision
event.description: Triggered when a collision is detected using active tests.

event.name: OnReset
event.description: Triggered when simulation is reset.

event.name: OnStartStop
event.description: Triggered when simulation is started or stopped.

property.name: IgnoreEvents
property.description: Defines if simulation object ignores event passing in order to avoid cyclic calls.

property.name: IsLooping
property.description: Defines if the simulation gets automatically restarted when finished.

property.name: IsRunning
property.description: Indicates if simulation is running in 3D world.

property.name: Name
property.description: Gets the name of simulation object.

property.name: ProcessController
property.description: Gets the global process controller.

property.name: SimSpeed
property.description: Defines the step size or speed of simulation.

property.name: SimTime
property.description: Gets the current time (in seconds) of simulation.

property.name: SimulationRunTime
property.description: Defines a time (in seconds) when simulation should stop running. Note: Changing the SimulationRunTime is only allowed in the OnRun event.

property.name: SimWarmupTime
property.description: Defines a time (in seconds) of simulation warmup time.

property.name: Statistics
property.description: Gets the statistics manager of simulation used for defining intervals.

property.name: World
property.description: Gets the simulation root node (3D world node).

method.name: addControlPoint
method.description: Adds a given point to end of vehicle path.

method.name: addOrientationPoint
method.description: If Interpolation is not zero, adds a given vector to vehicle in order to calculate vehicle orientation at its last control point. This method should be called immediately after adding control points to vehicle path. A given vector is not added to path.

method.name: attachWagonAtTheEnd
method.description: Attaches a given component to vehicle as a wagon. If no previous wagons, component is added as lead wagon. Otherwise, component is attached to last wagon added to vehicle. An optional distance argument can be given to offset distance component is attached to vehicle. By default, the method will use distance of component to vehicle at time of call.

method.name: calculateDecisionTimeToStopAt
method.description: Returns the total simulation time at which vehicle would need to decelerate (decision point) to stop at a given distance in calculated motion path.

method.name: calculateEnterExitBox
method.description: Returns the distance at which vehicle would enter and exit a box based on calculated path, starting distance of vehicle and a given precision. The Center, P1 and P2 arguments define box. The returned distances will be within one-half of precision to the theoretical intersection.
method.parameters: vcVector Center, vcVector P1, vcVector P2, Real distStartAt, Real precision

method.name: calculateFinishedTimeToStopAt
method.description: Returns the calculated total simulation time that vehicle will stop at a given distance based on calculated path.

method.name: calculateOffsetPathLength
method.description: Returns the length of calculated path for vehicle based on a given offset.

method.name: calculatePositionAt
method.description: Returns the position and direction of vehicle at a given time based on calculated path. If isElapsedTime argument is 0 (default), a given time is the elapsed time since start of vehicle movement. Otherwise, given time is elapsed time since start of simulation.

method.name: calculatePositionWithDistance
method.description: Returns the position of vehicle at a given distance in calculated path. The returned value is a tuple in which first element is position vector.

method.name: calculateSpeedAt
method.description: Returns the speed of vehicle on calculated path at a given time. If isElapsedTime argument is 0 (default), a given time is the elapsed time since start of vehicle movement. Otherwise, given time is elapsed time since start of simulation.

method.name: calculateTravelWithTime
method.description: Returns the distance traveled by vehicle on calculated path at a given time. If isElapsedTime argument is 0 (default), a given time is the elapsed time since start of vehicle movement. Otherwise, given time is elapsed time since start of simulation.

method.name: clearMove
method.description: Removes all points from calculated path of vehicle, thereby stopping vehicle movement. This method should be called at start of simulation before any control points are added to vehicle.

method.name: clearPassedPoints
method.description: Removes points from calculated path that have been reached by vehicle, thereby resetting the origin of calculated path and its length.

method.name: detachAllWagons
method.description: Detaches all wagons from vehicle and one another. This method should be called when simulation is reset; otherwise components will remain attached to one another.

method.name: getControlPointDistance
method.description: Returns the distance of a control point at a given index in vehicle based on calculated path. Note: If wagons are attached to vehicle, there will be control points with negative distances.

method.name: offsetPath
method.description: Offsets the calculated path of vehicle parametrically (X-axis is tangent, Y-axis is radial, Z-axis is up). This method should be called after adding points to vehicle.

method.name: rePlan
method.description: Clears all points from vehicle except those between vehicle and its wagons, thereby allowing you to replan route of vehicle using current speed, position and orientation. That is, the vehicle will not stop rather reroute itself to newly added control points.

method.name: resetStopAtDistance
method.description: Instructs vehicle to stop at a given distance on calculated path. This method allows you stop vehicle and recalculated route using same or different control points.

method.name: rotateInPlace
method.description:
Rotates vehicle by a given angle using given angularSpeed, angularAcceleration and angularDeceleration arguments.
Rotation will trigger OnMovementChanged and OnMovementFinished events. To ensure rotation is completed, use a delay, event or trigger before adding new control points to vehicle.
method.parameters: Real angle, Real angularSpeed, Real angularAcceleration, Real angularDeceleration

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the position of objects controlled by vehicle.

event.name: OnDecisionPointReached
event.description: Triggered when vehicle starts to decelerate in order to stop at target. That is, vehicle reaches decision point. The component of vehicle and time of occurrence are passed to event.

event.name: OnFinalDestinationReached
event.description: Triggered when vehicle reaches last target. That is, vehicle reaches last control point, and then stops with no more targets in queue. The component of vehicle and time of occurrence are passed to event.

event.name: OnMovementChanged
event.description: Triggered when vehicle route is modified, for example points cleared or added to vehicle or change in stop distance. The component of vehicle and time of occurrence are passed to event.

event.name: OnMovementFinished
event.description: Triggered when vehicle reaches target. The component of vehicle and time of occurrence are passed to event.

property.name: Acceleration
property.description: Defines the maximum acceleration (mm/s^2) of vehicle. That is, how fast vehicle can speed up.

property.name: Deceleration
property.description: Defines the maximum deceleration (mm/s^2) of vehicle. That is, how fast vehicle can slow down.

property.name: DecisionTime
property.description: Gets the amount of time it will take vehicle to execute a movement and reach decision point of calculated motion path. A decision point is the point at which vehicle will decelerate to stop at target. In some cases, a decision point is used to evaluate a vehicle and target location. For example, you may want to simulate vehicle routing and intersection crossing as well as evaluate if another vehicle is at target location.

property.name: Interpolation
property.description: Sets the tension (0 - n) of calculated motion path for vehicle to reach target. (Optional) Default value is 0, which will result in straight lines from each waypoint of path. The bigger the value, the longer the vehicle will navigate along the tangents of waypoints.

property.name: LengthIterations
property.description: Sets the number of iterations for each path segment when calculating Bezier path length. (Optional) Default value is 10. More iterations take longer to compute but give more precise results.

property.name: MaxSpeed
property.description: Defines the maximum speed (mm/s) of vehicle. That is, the top speed of vehicle.

property.name: OffsetMatrix
property.description: Sets an offset for vehicle origin and orientation. (Optional) Default is containing node's origin. In some cases, you may want to retain orientation of vehicle when moving in reverse or along an elevated path.

property.name: PathLength
property.description: Gets the length of motion path vehicle will use to reach a target.

property.name: TotalTime
property.description: Gets the total travel time of vehicle to reach a target using calculated path.

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets the command and clears its target data.

event.name: OnTargetAvailable
event.description: Triggered when pointer is hovering over a valid target in 3D world. The command itself as passed as an argument, thereby allowing you to access its updated properties.

event.name: OnTargetSet
event.description:
Triggered when a valid target has been selected in 3D world.
The command itself as passed as an argument, thereby allowing you to access its updated properties.

property.name: Snap
property.description: Turns on or off the ability to snap to a target.

property.name: SnapOnCircleCenter
property.description: Turns on or off the center of circles as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnCurve
property.description: Turns on or off curves as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnEdge
property.description: Turns on or off edges as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnEdgeCenter
property.description: Turns on or off the midpoint of edges as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnFaceCenter
property.description: Turns on or off the center of faces as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnFrame
property.description: Turns on or off frames as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnNodeCenter
property.description: Turns on or off the center of nodes as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnNodeOrigin
property.description: Turns on or off the origin of nodes as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnPoint
property.description: Turns on or off points on lines and polygons, for example corner points, as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnPolygon
property.description: Turns on or off polygons as potential targets.

property.name: SnapOnSurface
property.description: Turns on or off faces as potential targets.

property.name: TargetAvailable
property.description: Indicates if pointing at an available target in the 3D world.

property.name: TargetCircleCenterAvailable
property.description: Indicates if center of a circle is available as a target.

property.name: TargetCurve
property.description: Provides a list of positions for a target curve in World coordinate system.

property.name: TargetCurveAvailable
property.description: Indicates if a curve is available as a target.

property.name: TargetCurveIndex
property.description: Indicates the index position of a target curve in a geometry set.

property.name: TargetFaceCenterAvailable
property.description: Indicates if the center of a face is available as a target.

property.name: TargetGeoset
property.description: Indicates the geometry set of a target.

property.name: TargetLocked
property.description: Indicates if a target has been selected in the 3D world.

property.name: TargetMatrix
property.description: Indicates the position and orientation matrix for target in World coordinates.

property.name: TargetMatrixAvailable
property.description: Indicates if the position and orientation matrix for a target is available. (only valid for frame type targets)

property.name: TargetNode
property.description: Indicates the node containing a target.

property.name: TargetNormal
property.description: Indicates the normal vector of a target in World coordinates.

property.name: TargetNormalAvailable
property.description: Indicates if the normal vector of a target is available. (only valid for polygon and frame type targets).

property.name: TargetPosition
property.description: Indicates the position of a target in World coordinates.

property.name: TargetPrimitive
property.description: Indicates the geometry primitive object of a target.

property.name: TargetSurfaceAvailable
property.description: Indicates if the surface of a target is available.

property.name: TargetSurfaceIndex
property.description: Indicates the index position of a target surface in a component, for example the faces of a cube.

method.name: createProperty
method.description: Creates a new property of a given type and name in the statement, and then returns the new property. An optional constraints argument can be used to define constraints for new property, which must be defined at the time of creation. See Property Constants for more information.

method.name: deleteProperty
method.description: Deletes a given property in the statement.

method.name: getProperty
method.description: Returns a property matching a given name in the statement; otherwise returns None.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of the statement.

property.name: ParentScope
property.description: Gets the scope of the statement.

property.name: Properties
property.description: Gets a list of properties of the statement.

property.name: ParentRoutine
property.description: Gets the routine of the statement.

property.name: Type
property.description: Gets the statement's type. See Statement Constants for more information.

method.name: PartsAverageCount
method.description: Gets the average amount of components that have been contained in a component.

method.name: PartsAverageTime
method.description: Gets the average amount of time components spent in a component.

method.name: PartsCurrent
method.description: Gets the current amount of components contained in a component.

method.name: PartsEntered
method.description: Gets/Sets the number of components that have been transferred into a component. Generally, this property is set to reset a count or collect from the start of a new process.

method.name: PartsExited
method.description: Gets/Sets the number of components that have been transferred out of a component. Generally, this property is set to reset a count or collect from the start of a new process.

method.name: PartsMaxCount
method.description: Gets the maximum number of components that have been contained in a component at any given time.

method.name: PartsMaxTime
method.description: Gets the maximum amount of time a component has spent in a component.

method.name: PartsMinCount
method.description: Gets the minimum number of components that have been contained in a component at any given time.

method.name: PartsMinTime
method.description: Gets the minimum amount of time a component has spent in a component.

method.name: PartsTotalTime
method.description: Gets sum total of the amount of time each component had spent in a component, for example the duration of each component on a conveyor added together.

method.name: PartsUtilization
method.description: Gets the percentage of a component's capacity being utilized: number of parts divided by component's capacity.

method.name: PartsIntervalAverageCount
method.description:
Same as other flow type properties, yet each value reflects the last recorded interval during a simulation, which by default is every 60.0 seconds.
  See vcStatisticsManager for more information on how to change interval.

method.name: AverageActivePeriodTime
method.description: Gets the average amount of time a component was in one of its defined states.

method.name: BlockedPercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a blocked state, for example capacity issue, as a percentage of total time.

method.name: BreakPercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a broken state as a percentage of total time.

method.name: BusyPercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a busy state or was being used as a percentage of total time.

method.name: FailedPercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a failed state as a percentage of total time.

method.name: IdlePercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in an idle state as a percentage of total time.

method.name: RepairPercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a repair state as a percentage of total time. Scripting can be used to set repair time and include time waiting for a repair.

method.name: SetupPercentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a setup state, for example warm up time, as a percentage of total time.

method.name: State
method.description: Defines the current state of component. Use the States property to get an indication of available states in component.

method.name: State<name>Percentage
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component spent in a user-defined state as a percentage of total time. For example, StateExamplePercentage would refer to defined state called Example.

method.name: TotalStateTime
method.description: Gets the total amount of time a component was in one of its defined states based on total time.

method.name: Utilization
method.description: Gets the amount of time a component was busy during a simulation as a percentage (busy state/100 * 100%).

method.name: IntervalBlockedPercentage
method.description:
Same as other state based properties, yet each value reflects the last recorded interval during a simulation, which by default is every 60.0 seconds.
See vcStatisticsManager for more information on how to change interval.

method.name: flowEnter
method.description: Manually records a given component transferring into component.

method.name: flowLeave
method.description: Manually records a given component transferring out of component.

method.name: getIntervalPercentage
method.description: Returns the accumulated time of a given state as a percentage of the last recorded interval during a simulation.

method.name: getPercentage
method.description: Returns the accumulated time of a given state as a percentage of total time at the time of call.

method.name: getSystemIntervalPercentage
method.description: Returns the accumulated time of a given system_state as a percentage of the last recorded interval during a simulation.

method.name: getSystemPercentage
method.description: Returns the accumulated time of a given system_state as a percentage of total time at the time of call.

method.name: getSystemTime
method.description: Returns the accumulated time of a given system_state at the time of call.

method.name: getTime
method.description: Returns the accumulated time of a given state at the time of call.

method.name: warmupCompleted
method.description: Marks the completion/end of a component's warm up period, thereby setting all statistics to zero at the time of call. For example, a component can be configured to run a delay or a certain number of time consuming tasks at the start of a simulation. When this method is called, warm up time is calculated from simulation start to time of call.

event.name: OnFlowChange
event.description: Triggered when a component is transferred into or out of a component. The statistics argument is the Statistics behavior that recorded the event. The time argument is simulation time when flow change occurred. The incoming argument is True when component transfers in and False when component transfers out of component.
event.parameters: vcStatistics statistics, Real time, Boolean incoming, vcNode component

event.name: OnStateChange
event.description: Triggered when the state change occurs in a component. The statistics argument is the Statistics behavior that recorded the event. The time argument is simulation time when state change occurred. The state argument is the new state or system state of component. Refer to States or SystemStates property values as needed.
event.parameters: vcStatistics statistics, Real time, Integer state, vcNode component

property.name: ComponentMaxCount
property.description: Gets the maximum number of components that have been contained in a component at any given time.

property.name: ComponentMaxTime
property.description: Gets the maximum amount of time a component spent contained in a component.

property.name: ComponentMinCount
property.description: Gets the minimum number of components that been contained in a component at any given time.

property.name: ComponentMinTime
property.description: Gets the minimum amount of time a component spent contained in a component.

property.name: ComponentsArrived
property.description: Gets the total number of components that have been transferred into a component.

property.name: ComponentsAverageTime
property.description: Gets the average amount of time components have spent in a component.

property.name: ComponentsCurrent
property.description: Gets the total number of components currently contained in a component.

property.name: ComponentsDeparted
property.description: Gets the total amount of components that have been transferred out of a component.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of Statistics behavior.

property.name: States
property.description: Defines a list of defined states mapped to system states. A state must be mapped to a system state. See Statistics for more information.

property.name: SystemStates
property.description: Gets a list of available system states, which provides system state description and type. See Statistics Constants for more information.

method.name: addSeries
method.description: Adds a new data series to chart.

method.name: clearData
method.description: Removes all data reported by chart, thereby emptying DataRows.

method.name: clearSeries
method.description: Resets all data series in chart, thereby emptying AllSources.

method.name: deleteSeries
method.description: Deletes a given data_series from chart.

method.name: update
method.description: Refreshes the chart.

property.name: AllSources
property.description:
Gets all sources of reported items, including their components.
A reported item is a vcProperty object associated with a component. For example, a reported item could be a component property or a property of a component behavior. A vcVector object is used to define the display color of reported item in chart.

property.name: ChartTileType
property.description: Defines the location type of chart, thereby indicating whether the tile is an empty or filled with a chart. Generally, you would use ChartTileType to parse through several charts in a dashboard to collect data from charts that report items. For example, you could ignore or skip empty tiles.

property.name: ChartType
property.description: Defines the chart type. For more information, see Statistics Constants.

property.name: DataRows
property.description: Gets the data collected during a simulation from reported items.

property.name: DataType
property.description: Defines the data type of chart. For more information, see Statistics Constants.

property.name: FieldCountPerProperty
property.description: Defines the field count of items reported by chart.

property.name: LegendVisibility
property.description: Turns on/off the display of chart legend.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the title of chart.

property.name: Position
property.description: Defines the position chart in tab grid.

property.name: RecordAccumulatedValues
property.description: Turns on/off the collection of data reported by chart.

property.name: SamplingInterval
property.description: Defines how often (in seconds) the chart updates to show recorded data during a simulation. If -1, the chart uses the sampling interval of its dashboard.

property.name: Series
property.description: Gets a list of data series used by chart to report items.

property.name: TileType
property.description: Same as ChartTileType. For more information, see Statistics Constants.

property.name: TitleVisibility
property.description: Turns on/off the display of chart title.

method.name: createTab
method.description: Adds a new tab of a given name to the dashboard. The activate argument can be used to make the new tab the selected tab in dashboard.

method.name: deleteTab
method.description: Removes a given tab from the dashboard.

property.name: SelectedTab
property.description: Defines the active tab in dashboard.

property.name: StatisticsInterval
property.description: Defines the global sampling interval for reporting data. This will affect data series referencing vcStatistics properties as well as any chart with a sampling interval of -1.

property.name: Tabs
property.description: Gets a list of all tabs in dashboard.

property.name: SamplingInterval
property.description: Defines the sampling interval used by simulation for recording interval based statistics. The default rate is 60.0 seconds, so an interval is recorded every 60 seconds in simulation.

property.name: Colors
property.description: Defines the colors of series, which is displayed in chart. For example, data collected from different components should be color-coded to differentiate their data in chart.

property.name: Components
property.description: Defines the components the series collects data from during a simulation. In order to collect data, a listed component must have Property.

property.name: Expression
property.description: Defines the expression of series.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of series object.

property.name: ParentChart
property.description: Gets the chart of series.

property.name: Property
property.description: Defines the reported item (source) of series.

property.name: SeriesName
property.description: Defines the name of series, which is displayed in chart legend.

property.name: Sources
property.description: Gets a list of sources for series data. This information includes the reported item (vcProperty) and its component.

property.name: Thickness
property.description: Defines the display thickness of series, for example the line thickness of data collected from different components.

method.name: clearLayout
method.description: Deletes all charts from tab grid.

method.name: createChart
method.description: Adds a new chart of a given type to tab grid. The location argument specifies where in grid to insert the new chart. In this context, the vcStatisticsChart object is a grid location. It can be a chart with existing data or an empty chart used as a placeholder. For more information on the chart_type argument, see Statistics Constants.

method.name: begin
method.description:
Starts swept volume process, thereby initiating decomposition.
An optional vector argument can be given to define a frame of reference or center point in input node. If not, process uses center point of input node bound box.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all swept geometry of layout item from 3D world.

method.name: end
method.description: Stops swept volume process. After swept volume process has ended, you can perform capping of swept geometry.

method.name: next
method.description: Executes an iterative process that renders swept geometry based on positions of input nodes. That is, you should call this method each time you want to render swept volume in 3D world during swept process. An optional vector argument can be given to define a frame of reference or center point in input node as it moves during a simulation. If not, process uses center point of input node bound box. Generally, this is used to offset swept geometry.

method.name: store
method.description: Stores swept geometry in TargetNode, thereby allowing you to save swept geometry in component and/or layout. Returns the Geometry feature where swept volume is stored in TargetNode. The naming convention for feature is VC_SweptVolumeResult, and the feature is an immediate child of TargetNode root feature. If no swept geometry is generated during simulation, returns None. Generally, you should call store() method after calling end() method and before clear() method.

property.name: Decomposition
property.description: Defines the number of convex hulls created for included nodes, for example one conveyor hull encompassing all nodes or several convex hulls based on geometry of each node. 0 One convex hull. 1 One or more convex hulls using convex decomposition. 2 One convex hull for each triangle mesh in input nodes. See Decomposition Modes for more information.

property.name: DecompositionDecimationTarget
property.description: If Decomposition set to 1, sets the number of triangle sets remaining after decimation process of input nodes with fewer triangle sets than decimation target, thereby allowing you to expedite/speed up the process. Set to zero to have no effect.

property.name: DecompositionQuality
property.description: If Decomposition set to 1, sets the quality of decomposition in range 0 to 100, thereby affecting the approximation of convex hulls to the shape of input node geometry. A higher value produces better approximation and convex-shaped triangle sets at the cost of increasing a component's data count and simulation performance.

property.name: InputNodeList
property.description: Defines which nodes will be swept during a simulation. The value type is similar to Nodes property of a vcNodeList object in which a given node and its scope is either included or excluded from swept volume.

property.name: Method
property.description: Sets the method used for generating convex hulls as swept geometry, for example hollow or filled convex hulls. 0 Uses lofting. Good for movements requiring small changes, for example small rotational and directional changes in linear motions and bending of curves. 1 Uses hull from hulls generation. Creates internal faces and more points, thereby a higher data count but supports all types of movement. 2 Uses hull from silhouettes generation. Balance of methods 0 and 1 to support small and complex movements. Note: Each method type has about the same performance level. See Swept Generation for more information.

property.name: TargetNode
property.description: Sets the node used for containing swept geometry, which should be static and not move during simulation.

If index is less than zero or greater than the current case count, the case will be appended to the end. or Inserts an existing case to the given index. If index is less than zero or greater than the current case count, the case will be appended to the end.
method.parameters: None or Integer index or Integer index, vcCaseScope scope

method.name: releaseCase

method.name: getCase

event.name: OnCaseRemoved

property.name: Cases

property.name: Tools

Interpolation constants can be used with this property. Note: A conflict can occur if a base-tool pair in a referencing robot have the same IPOMode property value or cannot be used with the robot's current configuration.

method.name: brepAvailable
method.description: Returns True if set contains boundary representation; otherwise returns False.

method.name: createCurveLoop
method.description: Adds a new curve loop to a face at a given index in set, and then returns the index of new curve loop in set.

method.name: createNurbsFace
method.description: Adds a new non-uniform b-spline surface (NURBS) to set, and then returns the index of new surface in set.
method.parameters: Integer udegree, Integer vdegree, List of vcVector ctrl_pts, List of Integer umultiply, List of Integer vmultiply, List of Real uknots, List of Real vknots, List of Real uknots, List of Real ctrl_weights

method.name: createPlanarFace
method.description: Adds a new planar (unlimited) face using given position and surface normal vectors, and then returns the index of new face in set.

method.name: createOffsetSurface
method.description: Creates a copy of face at a given index in set, and then returns the index of new face in a given geometry set. New face is offset from original face. If offset argument is positive value, new face is offset in surface normal direction; otherwise offset is the opposite direction of surface normal.
method.parameters: Integer face, Real offset, vcTriangleSet target

method.name: createTrimPolyLine
method.description: Creates a new polyline using a curve loop at a given index in set, which can then be used for trimming and extending operations, and polyline is surface domain (XY coordinates only). The returned value is the index of trim polyline in set.

method.description: Create a new spline in set used for trimming and extending operations, and spline is surface domain (XY coordinates only).
method.parameters: Integer loop, Integer degree, List of vcVector ctrl_pts, List of Integer knotmultiply, List of real knots, List of Real weights

method.name: deleteNurbFace
method.description: Deletes a NURBS face at a given index in set. If NURBS surface contains more than one face, geometry is tessellated after deletion.

method.name: getCurveCurveLoop
method.description: Returns the index of curve loop that a curve belongs to in set.

method.name: getCurveFace
method.description: Returns the index of face that a curve belongs to in set.

method.name: getCurveIntersections
method.description: Returns a list of curve intersection points based on given arguments.
method.parameters: Integer face, vcCompactLineSet curveset, Integer curve

method.name: getCurveLength
method.description: Returns the length of a curve at a given index in set. That is, the total distance along the curve.

method.name: getCurveLoopCurve
method.description: Returns the absolute index of an inner curve loop relative to its curve loop in set.

method.name: getCurveLoopCurveCount
method.description: Returns the total number of inner curve loops for a curve loop of face in set.

method.name: getCurveNeighbor
method.description: Returns the index of a curve neighboring another curve in set.

method.name: getCurvePointCount
method.description: Returns the total number of points for a curve at a given index in set.

method.name: getCurvePointIndex
method.description: Returns the absolute index of point relative to its curve in set.

method.name: getCurvePosition
method.description: Returns the position matrix of a point on a curve at a given distance along curve. Details about the position matrix: Position vector Actual position of point on curve. Normal vector Direction of curve at the given point (derivative of curve position). Orientation vector Aligned to face inwards of curve's face. Approach vector Surface normal of face at curve position. See table footnotes for more information.

method.name: getCurvePositions
method.description: Returns a list of position matrices for points along a curve using different criteria. The minstep and maxstep arguments define the step values along distance of curve for generating new points. The maxerror argument defines a maximum distance error along length of curve for generating a new point. The maxangle argument defines a angle tolerance along curve for generating new points. See table footnotes for more information.
method.parameters: Integer curve_index, [Real minstep], [Real maxstep], [Real maxerror], [Real maxangle]

method.name: getCurveType
method.description: Returns a trim curve's type, which is either a polyline or spline. See Topology Constants for more information.

method.name: getFaceBound
method.description:
Returns bound box data for a face as an ordered pair (position matrix of bound box center, vector of bound box half-diagonal).
See table footnotes for more information.

method.name: getFaceCurveLoop
method.description: Returns the absolute index of a curve loop relative to its face in set.

method.name: getFaceCurveLoopCount
method.description: Returns the total number of curve loops in a face.

method.name: getFaceMinPointDistance
method.description: Returns UV coordinates, position vector and distance of a given point to a face.

method.name: getFaceNormal
method.description: Returns surface normal of a face at parametric UV coordinates.

method.name: getFacePlaneIntersections
method.description: Returns a list containing lists of position matrices for points where a defined plane intersects a face. Each time a plane goes through hole in face a new list is added, thereby allowing you to infer hole points on face-plane intersection. Details about the position matrix: Position vector Actual position of point intersection. Normal vector Direction along plane intersecting face. Orientation vector Projected from normal of plane to surface of face using face derivate for projected direction. Approach vector Surface normal of face. See table footnotes for more information.
method.parameters: Integer face_index, vcMatrix plane, Real minstep, Real maxstep, Real maxerror, Real maxangle

method.name: getFacePoint

method.name: getFacePointAndDerivate

method.name: getFaceTriangleCount

method.name: getNurbsFaceControlPoints

method.name: getNurbsFaceControlWeights
method.description: Returns a list of control weights for a NURBS face.

method.name: getNurbsFaceDegree
method.description: Returns UV degree values for a NURBS face.

method.name: getNurbsFaceUKnots
method.description: Returns U direction knot weight values and knot multiplicities.

method.name: getNurbsFaceVKnots
method.description: Returns V direction knot weight values and knot multiplicities.

method.name: getPlanarFacePositionAndNormal

method.name: getPolyLineCurvePoints
method.description: Returns a list of position vectors for all points in a polyline.

method.name: getPoint
method.description: Returns the position vector of a curve end (corner point) at a given index relative to either its curve or face.

method.name: getSplineCurveDegree

method.name: getSplineCurveControlPoints
method.description: Returns a list of control points for a face trimming spline.

method.name: getSplineCurveControlWeights
method.description: Returns a list of control weight values for a face trimming spline.

method.name: getSplineCurveKnots
method.description: Returns a list of knot weights and multiplicities for a face trimming spline as an ordered pair.

method.description: Trims a face at a given index in set using trimming polylines and/or splines. Returns 1/True if trimming is successful; otherwise returns 0/False.
