property.description: Gets all available transport controllers. Includes both system and user-implemented controllers.

property.name: ProductPosition
property.description: Target position where a product should be placed. This matrix is expressed in world coordinates and denotes the target position and orientation of the product. Note that this is not the same as the position and orientation of the product: the difference is the offset defined in the corresponding vcProductType.

property.name: ResourcePosition
property.description: Hint for the desired location of a resource while it is placing a product instance to the ProductPosition. Expressed in world coordinates.

property.name: ProductPositionNode
property.description:
By default, the node that contains ResourcePositionFrame, which is set in the transporting statement (TransportIn, TransportOut, or TransportPatternIn). If frames have not been selected, the statements use the transport node. In TransportOut, ProductPositionNode is set no None.
Reference node to ProductPositionInNode.   Note that a reference to the vcProduct itself can be used to get the current position of the product instance at any time.

property.name: ResourcePositionNode
property.description: By default, the node that contains ResourcePositionFrame, which is set in the transporting statement (TransportIn and TransportPatternIn). If frames have not been set, the statements use the transport node.   Reference node to ResourcePositionInNode.

property.name: ProductPositionInNode
property.description: Position in relation to ProductPositionNode, if the value of ProductPositionNode is not None.   The property can be used to transport the product from or into moving processes or nodes.

property.name: ResourcePositionInNode
property.description: Position in relation to ResourcePositionNode, if the value of ResourcePositionNode is not None.   The property can be used to transport the product from or into moving processes or nodes.

method.name: addPoint
method.description: Adds a point to set, and then returns index of point in set.
method.parameters:
vcVector vector
or Real x, Real y, Real z

method.name: addTriangle
method.description: Adds a triangle to set, and then returns new triangle count of set. See Example. Create sphere with triangle sets for more information.
method.parameters: Integer vertex1, Integer vertex2, Integer vertex3

method.name: collapsePoint
method.description: Collapses a point at a given index into another point at a given index in set, thereby updating triangles referencing first point to now reference second point. Generally, this is used to clean up redundant vertices, reduce data count or simplify geometry.

method.name: convexHull
method.description: Creates a convex hull from geometry of set. If value is True, returns a new triangle set containing the resultant geometry. If value is False, modifies the current geometry of set and returns the same set.

method.name: decimate
method.description: Simplifies triangles of set by merging points within a given maxError tolerance until a given quality level is achieved or tolerance is exceeded.

method.name: decompose
method.description: Regroups triangles in set into different sets based on the connection of each triangle to one another.

method.name: deleteTriangle
method.description: Deletes a triangle at a given index in set. You should call the update() method after deleting one or more triangles from set.

method.name: getClosestPointAndNormal
method.description: Returns the closest point to a given referencePoint in the set. The object coordinate system of the set is used to find the point, which is returned along with its surface normal.

method.name: getTexCoord1
method.description: Returns the texture coordinates of a point at a given index in set.

method.name: getTextureCoordinates
method.description: Returns a list containing an ordered pair of UV coordinates for points at given indices in set.

method.name: getPoint
method.description: Returns the position vector of point at a given index in set.

method.name: getPointIndexesWithin
method.description: Returns a list of indices for points in set within an area defined by a given position and side_length. A normal argument can be given to filter points with the same surface normal. See Example. Get position of points for more information.
method.parameters: vcVector position, Real side_length or vcVector position, Real side_length, vcVector normal

method.name: getPointNormals
method.description: Returns a list of surface normal vectors for points at a given list of indices in set. A convert argument can be used to transform each vector by a given matrix.
method.parameters: List of Integer indices or List of Integer indices, vcMatrix convert

method.name: getPointPositions
method.description: Returns a list of position vectors for points at a given list of indices in set. A convert argument can be used to transform each vector by a given matrix.
method.parameters: List of Integer indices or List of Integer indices, vcMatrix convert

method.name: getTriangle
method.description: Returns the indices of vertices for a triangle at a given index in set.

method.name: getTriangleEdgeNeighbor
method.description: Returns the index of a triangle neighboring another triangle at a given index and vertex in set. The vertex argument should be either 0, 1 or 2. The returned value is an ordered pair identifying neighboring triangle and shared vertex in set.

method.name: getTriangleEdgeType
method.description: Returns the type of edge for a triangle at a given index and vertex in set. The vertex argument should be either 0, 1 or 2. The returned type is one of seven possibilities: 0 = UNKOWN Type is unknown. 1 = LINE No triangle attached to edge. 2 = CO_PLANAR Two triangles attached to edge and their surface normals are parallel. 3 = SOFT Two triangles attached to edge and angle between surface normals is within angle tolerance of set, that is smooth surface. 4 = HARD Two triangles attached to edge and angle between surface normals is outside angle tolerance of set, that is coarse surface. 5 = BOUNDARY One triangle attached to edge. 6 = NON_MANIFOLD More than two triangles attached to edge.

method.name: getTriangleNormal
method.description: Returns the surface normal of a triangle at a given index in set.

method.name: mergePoints
method.description: Merges points of triangles within a given tolerance that are not connected to one another by adding lines. A onlyBoundaryPoints argument can be used to only merge points that border one another and that are within the given tolerance.
method.parameters: Real tolerance or Real tolerance, Boolean onlyBoundaryPoints

method.name: setPoint
method.description: Sets the position vector of a point at a given index in set.

method.name: setTexCoord1
method.description: Sets the texture coordinates of a point at a given index in set.
method.parameters: Integer index, Real u, Real v

method.name: setTextureCoordinates
method.description: Sets the texture coordinates of points at a given list of indices in set.
method.parameters: List of Integer indices, List of 2-tuple (Real u, Real v)

method.name: setTriangle
method.description: Sets the vertex indices of a triangle at a given index in set.
method.parameters: Integer index, Integer vertex1, Integer vertex2, Integer vertex3

method.name: subdivide
method.description:
Modifies triangles in set into smaller triangles with edge lengths smaller or equal to a given max_edge_length.
A max_triangles argument can be given to stop subdivision when triangle count reaches a maximum limit.
method.parameters: Real max_edge_length or Real max_edge_length, Integer max_triangles

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the set and its bound box.

property.name: CreaseAngle
property.description: Defines angle tolerance for triangle edge shading in which edge angles less than tolerance are rendered as smooth surfaces during light calculations.

property.name: DynamicTextureCoordinates1
property.description: Defines if texture coordinates of set can be updated during simulation.

property.name: DynamicUpdate
property.description: Defines if geometry of set can be updated during simulation.

property.name: Name
property.description: Defines the name of set.

property.name: PointCount
property.description: Gets the total number of points in set.

property.name: PolygonCount
property.description: Gets the total number of triangles in set.

property.name: PolygonTable
property.description: Defines a polygon table in the form of an ordered list used for generating triangles of set. In order to generate triangles, the vertex count of polygon is given first followed by the index for each vertex and so on for each subsequent polygon. For example, [3,0,1,2,3,0,2,3] would define two polygons with each having three vertices in which two are shared. Any polygon with four or more vertices will be tessellated. The actual positions of vertices are defined in PositionTable. See Example. Use polygon table to generate triangles for more information.

property.name: PositionTable
property.description: Defines a position table in the form of an ordered list used for generating triangles of set. In order to generate triangles, position values should have a known index and be in XYZ order. For example, [123.0,45.0,4.5,15.0,45.0,90.0] would define the position of two points which are aligned on Y-axis. If the number of entries is not enough for all points in set, those points will be deleted from set as a clean up operation. If number is more than is needed for points, additional points are created in set.

property.name: TextureCoordinateTable
property.description: Gets/Sets texture coordinates for points in set. f the number of entries is not enough for all points in set, those points will be deleted from set as a clean up operation. If number is more than is needed for points, additional points are created in set.

property.name: Topology
property.description: Gets the container of topology data for points in set.

property.name: TriangleCount
property.description: Gets the total number of triangles in set.

property.name: TriangleTable
property.description: Gets/Sets the triangle table of set, which is an ordered list of vertex indices for each triangle.

property.name: UseTextureCoordinates1
property.description: Turns on/off the use of texture coordinates in set.

method.name: convertFromCanonical
method.description: Converts a given canonical value to a unit value, and then returns the unit value.

method.name: convertToCanonical
method.description: Converts a given unit value to a canonical value, and then returns the canonical value.

method.name: getConstantExpression
method.description: Converts a given canonical value to a unit value, and then returns an expression of unit value with an appended unit specification.

method.name: getRelativeMagnitude
method.description: Returns the size of unit in relation to a given magnitude using a logarithm of unit factor and a given magnitude which must be greater than zero.

property.name: Factor
property.description: If unit is built-in, gets conversion factor; otherwise defines conversion factor. That is, the size of unit in canonical units which must be larger than zero.

property.name: Group
property.description: Gets the unit group of unit, which is defined at the time of unit creation.

property.name: IsBuiltIn
property.description: Indicates if unit is built-in.

property.name: Name
property.description: If unit is built-in, gets the unit's name; otherwise defines the name of unit.

property.name: Offset
property.description: If unit is built-in, gets zero-point offset; otherwise defines the canonical value at which the unit value is zero.

property.name: Suffix
property.description: If built-in, gets unit's suffix; otherwise defines the suffix of unit , which is displayed in GUI with property values.

method.name: addGroup
method.description: Adds a given unit group or one matching a given name to unit family, and then returns the index of unit group in unit family.

method.name: containsGroup
method.description: Returns True if a given unit group or one matching a given name is in the unit family; otherwise returns False.

method.name: removeGroup
method.description: Removes a given unit group or one matching a given name from unit family. Returns True if removal is successful; otherwise returns False if name does not match a unit group or throws an exception if unit group is built-in.

method.name: removeGroupAt
method.description: Removes a unit group at a given index from unit family. This method throws an exception if unit group is built-in.

property.name: Groups
property.description: Gets a list of all unit groups in unit family.

property.name: IsBuiltIn
property.description: Indicates if unit family is a built-in type. If True, adding and removing custom unit groups from unit family is allowed but not for built-in unit groups.

property.name: Name
property.description: If unit family is built-in, gets the unit family's name; otherwise defines the name of unit family which cannot contain any dot (.) characters.

method.name: createUnit
method.description: If not a built-in unit group, adds a new unit of a given name and suffix to unit group, and then returns the index of new unit in unit group. If built-in unit group, throws an exception.

method.name: deleteUnitAt
method.description: If not a built-in unit group, removes a unit at a given index in unit group. If built-in unit group, throws an exception.

method.name: getUnitWithMagnitude
method.description: Returns a unit in unit group that best matches a given magnitude.

property.name: IsBuiltIn
property.description: Indicates if unit group is a built-in group.

property.name: Name
property.description: If unit group is built-in, gets the unit group's name; otherwise defines the name of unit group which cannot contain any dot (.) characters.

property.name: Quantity
property.description: Gets the quantity referencing unit group.

property.name: Units
property.description: Gets a list of all units in unit group.

property.name: new
property.description: Creates a new vcVector object. One option allows you to give an existing vector, thereby creating a copy. A second option allows you to give three components for new vector. A third option allows you to give four components for new vector. A fourth option allows you to give no arguments, thereby creating a zero vector.
property.access:
vcVector vector
or Real x, Real y, Real z or Real x, Real y, Real z, Real w or [no argument]

property.name: IsAngular
property.description: Defines if vector quantity is angular or Cartesian type. If quantity is built-in, you can only get value.

property.name: Pair
property.description: Defines a vector quantity paired with the quantity in order to be used as matrix properties. If IsAngular is set to True, pair must be a Cartesian vector quantity; otherwise the pair must be an angular vector quantity. If quantity is built-in, you can only get value.

property.name: VectorName
property.description: Defines an alternative name for quantity instead of its inherited Name property. If value is None or empty string, quantity uses its inherited Name property.

property.name: CameraFar

property.name: CameraFovy
property.description: Defines the field of view (in degrees) for camera.

property.name: CameraIsOrtho
property.description: Turns on/off orthographic mode in camera.

property.name: CameraMatrix
property.description: Defines the location of camera in World coordinate system.

property.name: CameraNear
property.description: Defines the distance of near clipping plane from camera location.

property.name: Flags

property.name: Properties

property.name: ShadingEdge
property.description: Defines the shading mode of view. 0 No edges. 1 All edges. 2 Hard edges. 3 Silhouette edges (Currently not implemented). 4 Edge analysis.

property.name: ShadingRender
property.description: Defines rendering mode of view. 0 No rendering. 1 Bounding boxes. 2 No filling. 3 Background. 4 Constant filling (Currently not implemented). 5 Flat shaded. 6 Smooth shaded.
